title: Engineering Project Manager [IND]
description:
Location:
  
  
Noida, UP, IN, 201301
  
  
Requisition ID: 1364
  
  
Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder into a comprehensive Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solutions provider. Our portfolio now spans FPSO, FLNG, offshore renewables, floating production units, as well as major developments across onshore energy and infrastructure sectors.
  
  
This strategic expansion strengthens our ability to deliver exceptional project execution by seamlessly integrating the energy and infrastructure cultures of Asia and America across a diverse set of emerging markets and verticals. By expanding into onshore power plants, including gas-based and combined-cycle facilities, as well as onshore and offshore wind projects, in addition to our established offshore capabilities, we further broaden our commitment to providing world-class, end-to-end energy solutions.
  
  
Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team at the Energy Plant Unit and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the onshore and offshore industry. #OneEPU
  
  
**Position Overview**

* As a Project Engineer for FPSO topside design, you will be responsible for managing engineering activities related to the design, procurement, and execution phases of FPSO topside projects. You will ensure that engineering deliverables meet project timelines, specifications, and quality standards while working closely with both internal and external teams.
* Furthermore, the Topside EPM will work in close cooperation with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure that engineering work and deliverables are compliant with all project requirements, classification rules, design codes and industry standards as well as any relevant regulatory aspect.
* The ideal candidate of the position will have a strong background in Offshore Oil & Gas Industry and have prior experience as a Project Engineer in FPSO projects and with prior experience in detailed engineering for offshore projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Engineering Manager in the coordination and execution of topside design activities.
* Assist in the preparation of project scopes, schedules, and budgets.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure the successful integration of design and execution phases.
* Establish engineering schedule and manpower plan to ensure that the work is completed in accordance with the overall project schedule. Prepare and issue regular progress reports including actual progress achieved vs. original plan.
* Record Interface Register and monitor and report area of concerns and close - out status regularly.
* Monitor engineering progress, identify potential risks, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Review and approve technical documentation, drawings, and specifications for the project.
* Provide technical support during construction, fabrication, and installation phases.
* Maintain strong communication with clients, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure project alignment.
* Conduct technical evaluations and reviews to ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Marine, offshore Technology, or related field).
* Minimum of 10~15 years of experience in engineering roles, with at least 5 years in project management, coordination, offshore execution or technical support within the oil and gas industry, particularly involving FPSO projects.
* Familiarity with FPSO systems, equipment, and design standards.
* Strong knowledge of project management principles and methodologies.
* Proficiency with engineering design software (e.g., AutoCAD, PDMS, etc.).
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skill

**Diversity And Inclusion**
Hanwha believes that diversity and inclusion are vital to our success. We believe that by embracing different ideas and approaches, we enhance our ability to deliver the best results for our employees, our environment, and ultimately our business partners and customers. We foster a culture where all colleagues are able to share their passions and ideas in order that we may collectively embrace and overcome the challenges in our industry, and work toward a brighter future.
  
  
Hanwha is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other federally protected class.

title: Senior Project Manager (UK Shift)
description:
Job Description: Senior Project Manager

**Company:**
QBS Learning

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 3

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office; work-from-home arrangements will be discussed

**Shift:**
UK Shift

**Experience:**
8+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Preferred Certification:**
PMP

About QBS Learning:

QBS Learning is a global education solutions partner with over 35 years of experience supporting educational publishers, EdTech companies, and learning organisations. We specialise in K-12 curriculum and content development, educational publishing, digital learning solutions, accessibility, and technology-enabled content production.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a senior, experienced Project Manager with a strong background in K-12 EdTech, educational publishing, ELT (English Language Teaching), or digital learning content production.

The ideal candidate must have proven experience managing complex projects, including
**POC (Proof of Concept) projects**
, with multiple stakeholders, long production schedules, and strict quality and delivery requirements.

The candidate will establish project management processes at project kick-off and ensure they are followed throughout the project lifecycle. This includes maintaining centralised documentation of project plans, design decisions, client comments, feedback, revisions, approvals, risks, and status updates to ensure transparency, accountability, and smooth project execution.

Experience managing large-scale ELT programmes or similar educational content projects will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities:1. End-to-End Project Management:

* Lead projects from initiation and kick-off through planning, execution, quality review, delivery, and closure.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, timelines, deliverables, resource requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop project plans and establish clear workflows, review cycles, approval processes, and communication protocols.
* Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Identify risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies proactively and implement mitigation plans.

2. POC (Proof of Concept) Project Management:

* Manage POC projects from initial requirements and planning through execution, evaluation, client review, and final recommendations.
* Define POC objectives, scope, timelines, deliverables, success criteria, and evaluation metrics.
* Coordinate with clients and cross-functional teams to develop and validate sample content, workflows, features, or solutions.
* Track progress, dependencies, risks, issues, and feedback throughout the POC lifecycle.
* Maintain centralised documentation of requirements, design decisions, client comments, revisions, testing outcomes, and approvals.
* Evaluate POC results against agreed success criteria and present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Coordinate the transition from an approved POC to full-scale implementation or production, where applicable.

3. Project Governance & Documentation

* Establish project governance, documentation standards, and communication protocols at project kick-off.
* Ensure agreed processes are consistently followed by internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
* Maintain centralised records of project plans, design decisions, feedback, change requests, revisions, approvals, and action items.
* Ensure all decisions and updates are documented, traceable, and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain version control, decision logs, issue trackers, risk registers, and change-control documentation.
* Use
  **Smartsheet**
  for project planning, tracking, dashboards, reporting, and workflow management.

4. K-12 Educational Publishing & ELT Projects

* Manage complex educational content and publishing programmes involving multiple grade levels, content components, deliverables, and long production schedules.
* Coordinate editorial, curriculum, instructional design, content development, design, production, technology, and quality assurance teams.
* Monitor content development, design reviews, feedback incorporation, revisions, approvals, and final production.
* Ensure consistency across project levels, content formats, and deliverables while maintaining quality and curriculum alignment.
* Manage client feedback and design decisions systematically to minimise rework and conflicting instructions.

5. Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders.
* Lead kick-off meetings, POC reviews, project progress meetings, and delivery discussions.
* Translate client requirements into actionable project plans and measurable milestones.
* Communicate progress, risks, delays, dependencies, and corrective actions proactively.
* Manage expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure timely decisions and approvals.
* Build strong relationships with international clients, particularly those operating in the UK and other global markets.

6. Resource Management & Continuous Improvement

* Coordinate internal teams, vendors, and production partners to ensure effective resource utilisation.
* Track team capacity, workloads, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Facilitate collaboration between editorial, content, design, production, QA, and technology teams.
* Prepare dashboards, status reports, milestone trackers, risk reports, and management updates.
* Monitor project performance against scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and KPIs.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce rework, and enhance project efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 8+ years of project management experience, preferably in K-12 EdTech, educational publishing, ELT, e-learning, or digital content production.
* **Mandatory hands-on experience managing POC (Proof of Concept) projects**
  , preferably within EdTech, educational publishing, digital learning, or technology-enabled content solutions.
* Proven ability to define POC scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, success criteria, and evaluation metrics.
* Experience coordinating POC execution, client feedback, testing, documentation, stakeholder reviews, and outcome presentations.
* Strong expertise in project planning, scheduling, milestone tracking, risk management, change control, and delivery governance.
* **Hands-on experience with Smartsheet**
  for project planning, tracking, dashboards, reporting, and workflow management.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects with multiple deliverables and long production schedules.
* Strong understanding of educational publishing, K-12 content production, or ELT workflows.
* Experience maintaining decision logs, feedback trackers, change requests, approval records, and version histories.
* Excellent client communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Ability to establish processes at kick-off and ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Willingness to work the UK shift and attend the Noida Sector 3 office, with any work-from-home arrangement to be discussed.

We are opening applications for:

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day in the life:**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.
  
  

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.
  
  

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.
  
  

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll be perfect for the role if you have:**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

#FCMIN
  
  
**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**
FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
  
  
You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
  
  
**Market Aligned remuneration structure**
and a highly competitive salary
  
  
**Fun and Energetic culture**
: At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
  
  
**Work life Balance**
: We believe in “No Leave = No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
  
  
**Great place to work**
- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
  
  
**Wellbeing Focus**
- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
  
  
**Paternity Leave:**
We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
  
  
**Travel perks**
: You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
  
  
**A career, not a job**
: We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
  
  
**Reward & Recognition**
: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  
  
**Love for travel**
: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  
  
**We value you...**
Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
  
  
**Who We Are...**
Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
  
  
As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe - 20+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
  
  
We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
**Brightness of Future.**
We encourage you to
**DREAM BIG**
through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.

* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

*Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.*

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
*Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.*

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
*Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.*

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.

title: NU-Project Execution Lead Planner
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Établit et maintient la cohérence des performances, des attributs fonctionnels et physiques d'un produit avec ses exigences, sa conception, ses informations opérationnelles et gère les modifications tout au long du cycle de vie du système. Offre une visibilité et un contrôle des performances du système, des attributs fonctionnels et physiques. Vérifie qu'un système fonctionne comme prévu, et qu'il est identifié et documenté avec suffisamment de détails pour prendre en charge son cycle de vie prévu. Facilite la gestion ordonnée des informations système et des modifications système à des fins utiles, telles que la révision de la capacité ; améliorer les performances, la fiabilité ou la maintenabilité ; prolonger la vie ; réduire les coûts ; réduire les risques et la responsabilité ; ou corriger les défauts.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Technical Program Manager – Job Description

Technical Program Manager (Delhi/Gurgaon/Noida) to drive program execution at a deep-tech semiconductor company and represent it, alongside the founder and CTO, to key stake holders in Government, industry partners and customers.

About Ananant Systems

Ananant Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a Noida-based fabless semiconductor company building AI-native DSP SoCs and systems for 5G wireless infrastructure, Edge and Vision AI, and cellular IoT. We work with Government, defence, international partners, customers and investors, and are scaling from silicon and product development into programs and deployments.

The role

The Technical Program Manager owns execution of Ananant's programs end to end and is the founder's and CTO's right hand in external engagements. You will split your time between running internal programs and representing the company to key stakeholders in Government, partners, vendors and customers.

Item

Detail

Title

Technical Program Manager

Location

Delhi NCR (Noida/Gurgoan/Delhi), on-site with regular travel

Reports to

Founder and CTO

Works with

Engineering, product, finance, and external stakeholders

Travel

Frequent: state capitals, partner and customer sites; occasional international

Key responsibilities

**Internal program execution**

* Own program plans, milestones, dependencies and risk registers across systems, silicon, hardware, software and product teams; run weekly reviews and escalate early.
* Track deliverables, budgets and schedules for funded programs and customer engagements, and report status to the founder and CTO.
* Coordinate with foundry, EMS, IP and tool vendors on schedules, deliveries and commercial terms.
* Build and maintain processes, templates and dashboards that bring discipline to a fast-moving engineering organization.

**External stakeholders**

* Manage/co-ordinate engagement with key stake holders in Government, industry partners, customers and investors; prepare briefs, follow up and close action items.
* Write and manage technical proposals, grant applications, project reports and presentations for Central and state Government and defence agencies.
* Negotiate with vendors and partners on pricing, timelines, scope and agreements, with support from the founder.
* Manage compliance, reporting and milestone-linked disbursements for grants and sponsored programs.
* Maintain the stakeholder map and relationship history so that no commitment is dropped.

Qualifications

**Education**

* Engineering and/or management degree (B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA or equivalent) from a Tier 1 institution such as the IITs, IIMs, IISc or BITS, or an equivalent global institution.
* Education and/or work experience outside India is preferred.

**Domain knowledge**

Working understanding of products, applications and markets in:

* Wireless and telecom infrastructure (4G/5G, small cells, RAN)
* Industrial and IoT systems
* Edge AI, camera and vision systems
* Semiconductors and SoC development flow
* Drones and robotics

**Skills and experience**

* Strong technical documentation: proposals, project reports, grant applications, briefing notes and executive presentations.
* Proven vendor and partner negotiation, covering pricing, contracts and delivery terms.
* Experience working with Government entities (ministries, state agencies, PSUs) and defence organizations, including grant, tender and procurement processes.
* Track record managing cross-functional technical programs with multiple external dependencies.
* Prior experience in a startup, semiconductor, telecom or deep-tech environment is an advantage.

Personal attributes

* **Very high energy:**
  thrives in a fast-paced environment with many parallel threads and frequent travel.
* **Ownership:**
  takes a task from assignment to closure without being chased, and flags problems early.
* **Relationship builder:**
  earns trust quickly with senior officials, executives and founders, and keeps relationships warm over time.
* **Clear communicator:**
  writes crisp, accurate documents and speaks credibly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Negotiator:**
  firm on outcomes, fair on terms, and conscious of long-term partnerships.
* **Judgment and discretion:**
  handles sensitive Government, defence and commercial information with care.

title: Clinical Trial Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**Clinical Trial Project Manager (CPM)**
to lead cross-functional study teams in the execution of Phase I–IV clinical trials. The CPM is responsible for the overall operational management, planning, implementation, and close-out of clinical studies according to defined scope, timeline, budget, and regulatory standards. This role acts as the central hub of communication between clinical study teams, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), vendors, investigators, and regulatory authorities to ensure high-quality data integrity and participant safety.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Management & Trial Leadership

* Drive the full lifecycle of clinical trials from study start-up through database lock, clinical study report (CSR) completion, and trial close-out.
* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive
  **Project Management Plans (PMP)**
  , cross-functional timelines, resource allocation, and milestone schedules.
* Lead cross-functional study team meetings (e.g., Clinical Research Associates, Data Managers, Biostatisticians, Medical Writers) to ensure operational alignment.
* Monitor project status against key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive proactive risk mitigation and contingency planning.

2. Vendor & Site Management

* Oversee selection, contract negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of third-party vendors and CROs.
* Coordinate site feasibility, selection, activation, and investigator meetings alongside clinical site monitoring teams.
* Manage vendor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and track performance metrics to ensure contractual deliverables are met on time.

3. Financial & Resource Management

* Manage multi-million dollar trial budgets, accurately track monthly project accruals, forecast expenditures, and review vendor invoices.
* Identify scope changes and steward the evaluation, negotiation, and implementation of vendor change orders.

4. Quality Assurance, Compliance & Inspection Readiness

* Ensure all trial activities comply with ICH-GCP, FDA/EMA regulations, local regulatory requirements, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Maintain continuously updated Trial Master Files (TMF/eTMF) to preserve inspection readiness throughout the trial lifecycle.
* Manage protocol deviations, track Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans, and support internal audits or regulatory inspections.

Requirements & QualificationsEducation & Experience

* **Bachelor’s Degree**
  in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or related scientific discipline (Master’s or PharmD preferred).
* **4–6+ years**
  of direct experience in clinical trial operations within a CRO, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical company.
* Minimum
  **2+ years**
  in a project management or trial management leadership capacity.
* Strong track record of managing multi-center or global Phase II–III clinical studies.

description:
**Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate, Clean Energy**

The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is inviting applications for the positions of Programme Lead and Senior Programme Associate under its Clean Energy Programme.

We are looking for experienced, motivated professionals with a strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, demonstrated analytical and research capabilities, and a proven track record in programme execution, advisory and implementation-oriented assignments. The role also requires excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder engagement skills to support high-impact clean energy transition initiatives across states and sectors.

https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8

Required Experience for
**Programme Lead**
: 10+ years

Required Experience for
**Senior Programme Associate**
: 5–7 years

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Reporting to: Director, Clean Energy (Programme Lead) / Programme Lead, Clean Energy (Senior Programme Associate)

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. Our mission is to identify, promote and scale up solutions for critical environment-development challenges in India and other developing regions across Asia and Africa.

We focus on regional priorities to accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level, while influencing national policies and plans to support these efforts. By drawing on our resources and expertise, we aim to address regional needs, strengthen national action and contribute to global solutions.

Our work involves independent, evidence-based research, developing innovative solutions, convening stakeholders to build consensus, and partnering with think tanks, civil society organisations, government agencies, philanthropies and industry leaders.

**The Clean Energy Programme**

The iFOREST Clean Energy Programme focuses on accelerating equitable renewable energy growth in India by supporting clean energy deployment in underserved states, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions.

The programme supports state governments through policy and regulatory reform, implementation strategies, techno-economic assessments, investment facilitation and institutional capacity building. Its focus states include Odisha, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. The work prioritises land-neutral technologies such as floating solar, agri-PV, rooftop solar, storage and green hydrogen.

**The Role**

The Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate will drive research, policy advisory and implementation activities under the Clean Energy Programme. The Programme Lead will anchor delivery of the programme, working closely with the Director across research, engagement, technical support and implementation, and will manage teams and workstreams. The Senior Programme Associate will lead the execution of key assignments, particularly on industrial renewable energy adoption, demand aggregation and investment mobilisation in Uttar Pradesh and other priority states.

The selected candidates will work closely with state governments, renewable energy agencies, utilities, industrial associations, MSMEs, development partners and other stakeholders to develop and implement renewable energy transition initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of ongoing and planned projects, ensuring timely delivery of committed activities, outputs, milestones and reporting requirements
* Design and manage workplans, research methodologies, analytical frameworks and implementation strategies for programme assignments
* Conduct and oversee primary and secondary research, techno-economic assessments and policy analysis on industrial RE adoption, RE procurement, demand aggregation and storage integration
* Lead preparation of research reports, policy briefs, technical outputs, regulatory recommendations and investment-oriented strategies, with analytical rigour and quality control
* Support the design and operationalisation of RE demand aggregation initiatives and pilot projects in industrial clusters
* Build and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, utilities, industries, MSMEs, research institutions, CSOs, media and development partners
* Lead stakeholder consultations, workshops, trainings, convenings and field engagements
* Represent iFOREST in external meetings, consultations, conferences and sectoral discussions
* Contribute to programme development, including concept notes, technical proposals, budgets, pitch materials and partnership building
* Manage and mentor programme teams, supporting work allocation, progress tracking and capacity building (Programme Lead)
* Undertake any additional responsibilities related to the advancement of the Clean Energy Programme and institutional priorities

**Qualification & Work Experience**

At least a master’s degree from a recognised institution in a relevant field, such as energy policy, public policy, economics, management, renewable energy, engineering or a related discipline.

Around 10 years of relevant experience for the Programme Lead, and 5–7 years for the Senior Programme Associate, in research, strategy consulting, advisory, programme implementation or policy engagement focused on the renewable energy sector.

A demonstrated track record of producing high-quality research and advisory outputs, such as reports, briefs, assessments, presentations and implementation frameworks.

Experience of working with government agencies, utilities, industries, industry associations, development partners or research institutions will be an advantage.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, including its policies, regulations, programmes, technologies, industrial markets, open access, captive energy and implementation challenges
* Proven experience in qualitative and quantitative research, policy analysis and techno-economic assessments
* Strong programme execution and project management capabilities
* Ability to engage effectively with government, industry, research institutions, CSOs and development partners
* Strong analytical, writing, presentation, communication and problem-solving skills

title: HVDC Project Director
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Project Director – HVDC is responsible for the overall leadership and successful execution of major HVDC transmission projects within GE Vernova Grid Solutions. The role has full accountability for project performance across EHS, Quality, Schedule, Cost, Cash, Risk, Contract Management, and Customer Satisfaction.
  
  
As a senior leader within the project organization, the Project Director drives execution excellence across the full project lifecycle, from contract handover through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and final acceptance. This role ensures strong alignment with GE Vernova’s operational rigor, compliance standards, and customer commitments while leading complex, cross-functional, and international project teams.
  
  
The Project Director plays a critical role in delivering strategic grid infrastructure projects that support the energy transition, power system reliability, and grid modernization.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Ownership and Execution Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end execution of large and complex HVDC projects in accordance with contractual obligations and GE Vernova business objectives.
* Own overall project results including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost performance, cash collection, margin protection, and customer satisfaction.
* Define and implement the project execution strategy, governance model, and operating rhythm.
* Ensure disciplined execution across all project phases including engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, transport, site activities, erection, commissioning, and handover.
* Drive execution excellence through structured reviews, clear accountability, and proactive issue resolution.
* Customer and Stakeholder Leadership
* Act as the senior point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong and trusted customer relationships, ensuring transparent communication and effective escalation management.
* Lead executive customer reviews, project governance meetings, and strategic discussions.
* Manage interfaces with utilities, TSOs, consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, local authorities, and other external stakeholders.
* Represent GE Vernova professionally in high-impact customer and partner engagements.
* Commercial, Financial, and Contractual Management
* Own project financial performance including revenue, profitability, cost control, billing milestones, cash flow, and forecast accuracy.
* Ensure effective management of project changes, claims, variation orders, contingencies, and contractual risks.
* Partner closely with finance, legal, commercial, and contract management teams to protect GE Vernova’s interests and optimize project outcomes.
* Drive strong project review discipline, including estimate-at-completion, risk exposure, cash forecasting, and recovery planning where required.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, governance requirements, and internal approval processes.
* Risk and Opportunity Management
* Lead project risk and opportunity management with a proactive and data-driven approach.
* Ensure identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of key technical, operational, commercial, and schedule risks.
* Direct the implementation of mitigation and recovery plans for critical project issues.
* Escalate significant risks and execution challenges in a timely and structured manner.
* Promote a culture of anticipation, transparency, and ownership across the project team.
* Cross-Functional Integration
* Lead a multidisciplinary project team across engineering, project management, sourcing, logistics, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, finance, contract management, quality, and EHS.
* Ensure strong integration and alignment between global and regional teams involved in project delivery.
* Drive effective interface management across internal functions, subcontractors, and customer organizations.
* Ensure smooth coordination between project execution and key support functions to maintain delivery performance.
* Foster collaboration across matrixed and geographically dispersed teams.
* EHS, Quality, and Compliance
* Champion GE Vernova’s safety-first culture and ensure EHS is embedded in all project activities.
* Drive compliance with GE Vernova standards, customer requirements, applicable regulations, and industry codes.
* Ensure robust quality planning, assurance, and execution across all project phases.
* Promote a culture of integrity, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Ensure lessons learned, quality feedback, and continuous improvement actions are captured and applied.
* Governance, Reviews, and Operational Rigor
* Establish strong project governance and ensure regular operating reviews, performance tracking, and transparent reporting.
* Lead internal project reviews with business leadership and provide clear visibility on performance, risks, actions, and decisions needed.
* Use project controls and KPIs to drive execution rigor and informed decision-making.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of schedule, cost, risk, progress, and cash metrics.
* Support implementation of standard work, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across Grid Solutions project execution.
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing project teams in a global matrix environment.
* Set clear expectations for accountability, execution discipline, customer focus, and teamwork.
* Coach senior project leaders and functional managers to strengthen project execution capability.
* Build an inclusive, performance-oriented culture aligned with GE Vernova values and leadership expectations.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and knowledge transfer across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in project execution, with substantial leadership responsibility in major transmission or energy infrastructure projects.
* Proven record of delivering large and complex projects involving multiple interfaces, international teams, and demanding customer requirements.
* Prior success in senior project leadership roles such as Project Director, Program Director, Senior Project Manager, or Head of Project Execution.
* Significant project leadership experience in HVDC, FACTS, substations, transmission, grid systems, or large EPC infrastructure projects.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, IPMA, or equivalent will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in multinational project environments and matrix organizations.
* Experience with consortium projects, utility customers, TSOs, and complex EPC contract models.
* Familiarity with GE Vernova or comparable governance, project controls, and compliance frameworks is an advantage.

**Technical And Leadership Skills**

* Deep understanding of HVDC project delivery, transmission technologies, and complex grid infrastructure execution.
* Strong financial, commercial, and contractual management capability.
* Executive-level customer engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong project governance, planning, and performance management capability.
* Ability to lead in complex, ambiguous, and fast-changing project environments.
* Strong communication, negotiation, influencing, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to drive accountability and execution across matrixed teams.
* High level of operational rigor and results orientation.

**Success Measures**

* Strong EHS performance across all project phases
* Delivery of HVDC projects in line with committed schedule, budget, quality, and cash targets
* Effective management of risk, opportunities, claims, and contract obligations
* Positive customer feedback and strong relationship outcomes
* Robust governance, forecasting accuracy, and execution transparency
* High-performing, engaged, and accountable project teams
* Successful project commissioning, acceptance, and closeout

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Construction Manager
description:
Hi,

Greetings from Peoplefy Infosolutions !!!

We are hiring for one of our reputed client based in
**Noida/ Pune/ Navi Mumbai**
.

We are looking for candidates with 14+ years of experience.

**Education: B.E./ B. Tech (Electrical/Mechanical)**

**Job Description:**

The Construction Manager will take the ownership of leading the project from inception till handover. He / She would lead a team of resources from varied technical backgrounds and also a team of other project stakeholders that would include architects, vendors, and contractors and manage the project throughout the complete lifecycle through seamless delivery of an end to end Project Management scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Charter**

* Understand the project requirements from the client and develop a detailed Project Charter that would include a broad strategy for delivering the Project Management Scope, identification of key stakeholders who would be required from the project inception till closure, define the procurement plan that is merged with the baseline schedule and spell out critical milestones that would be the guiding factor for successful project completion
* Align all the key stakeholders with the Charter and prepare a draft Project Execution Plan
* Collaborate with clients team and prepare a project matrix clearly defining the process for flow of information and internal approval process

**2. Project Planning**

* Provide inputs with regards to sequencing of activities in the master schedule to include design reviews, drawing delivery schedule, procurement, equipment delivery and installation, construction sequencing and testing & commissioning plans
* Guide the project Planning Manager / Engineer in finalizing the Master Schedule in the inception stage (after acceptance of Project Charter) and then finalizing the detailed project schedule in the final design concept stage (before commencement of Procurement activities)

**3. High level budgeting and costing**

* Develop high level budget based on available details and with support from planning, civil and MEP teams during the inception stage and update the costing during different stages of the project ie from concept stage to vendor / supplier finalization.
* Establish unit rates for materials and labor based on current market data and historical benchmarks
* Regularly update cost database to reflect trends and regional price fluctuations

**4. Tendering & Bid Support**

* Lead the tendering process by developing contractor / subcontractor scopes, bid assumptions, relevant tender clauses and risk allowances
* Analyze tender documents, drawings, and specifications to determine labor, material, and equipment requirements
* Suggest clients on tender clarifications, tender event schedule and evaluate technical submissions by vendors / suppliers in line with clients requirements
* Carry out vendor / supplier evaluation (with support from project teams) with respect to technical details and project delivery
* Take ownership of the Tender Event Schedule right up to the award of contract

**5**
.
**Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Plan for Value Engineering workshop during the concept design and then before design finalization stage of the project
* Identify opportunities to reduce cost by suggesting alternate materials, or design modifications.
* Guide the planning and design management teams to update on schedule, delivery status and change management

**6. Coordination & Collaboration**

* Coordinate with team members during all the stages of the project to ensure plans are updated as per project status
* Proactively involve in the Risk Management scope and suggest mitigation measures as and when a risk is identified so as to keep the project timelines and cost intact
* Collaborate with the clients team through regular exchange of information, periodic updates and meetings, keeping them informed about the progress at different stages of the project and raising red flags as and when attention is required that needs early resolution
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure design / drawing delivery is as per agreed schedule and support the team in case their delivery is getting affected due to inputs and approvals from required stakeholders
* Collaborate with construction contractor right from their onboarding stage and through the construction process for a seamless execution as per plan, desired quality standards and within assigned project budget
* Conduct regular reviews with key stakeholders to ensure risks are identified proactively and mitigated, project delivery plans are intact and identification of bottlenecks and early resolution
* Conduct site visits, resolve RFIs, and ensure design intent during construction
* Provide support to the respective teams in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) if these activities are part of our scope

**7. Change Management**

* Prepare a detailed change management process that is defined at the beginning of the project, approved by client and accepted by all stakeholders
* Ensure the updates on change management are included as part of periodic report to the client
* Review the changes that arise during different project stages with regards to the impact on cost, quality and timelines and ensure if the impact can be minimized through any value engineering initiative before it is submitted for approval to the client

**8. Contract Administration**

* Ensure a draft contract is prepared as per project requirement and shared with the clients team for their approval
* Study and prepare a draft response to any queries that arise from contractor / vendor / suppliers with regards to understanding of the contract as well as during their delivery period
* Support the clients team in case of any legal issues or arbitrations raised by contractor / vendor / suppliers during their respective contract periods and help in preparing draft responses in line with related contract clause

**9.**
**Project Handover and Closeout**

* Coordinate with Design, Contractor and Vendor / Supplier teams with regards to their respective project timelines and ensure timely closure of their scope as per agreed timelines
* Support project teams to develop a detailed Handover Document to include financial closure that is reviewed and checked in line with the project cost to completion (as per updates during the project life-cycle)

**10. Continuous Improvement**

* Coordinate with all stakeholders to capture lessons learnt and review operational feedback that can be included as a process / project delivery improvement plan for subsequent projects

**Interested candidates for above position kindly share your CVs on-**

***sneh.ne@peoplefy.com***

Thank you,

Sneh

**Assistant Cost Manager**

The ideal candidate will have over 12 years of experience in quantity surveying, cost planning, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, and financial reporting. Cost Control & Reporting

Stakeholder Management

* Support client presentations and commercial review meetings.

  **12 years of relevant experience**

* Expertise in quantity surveying and contract administration.
* Knowledge of standard forms of contracts (FIDIC, NEC, JCT, etc.).
* Strong commercial acumen and financial analysis skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and cost management software.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

* Review contractors’ mobilisation and logistics plans: manpower, material storage, vertical transport and access control.
* Build the integrated master programme (procurement → construction → testing and commissioning → snagging → handover) and track progress against it.
* Track the critical path, flag delays early and recommend recovery measures.

**Contract compliance**

* Review each executed contract and keep the Contract Obligation Compliance Matrix up to date.
* Flag non-compliance on programme, submittals, resources and handover obligations, and recommend corrective actions.

**Quality**

* Review contractors’ QA/QC plans and carry out regular workmanship inspections against the approved specifications.
* Raise non-conformances and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

**Cash flow and risk**

* Prepare the project cash flow forecast and hold fortnightly cash flow reviews with the Client.
* Keep the Project Risk Register up to date, covering impact and probability, mitigation and contingency.

**Reporting and handover**

* Sign off the Weekly Project Report, including the executive summary, decisions needed from the Client and 2- and 4-week look-aheads.
* Lead joint snagging inspections, the snag rectification schedule and re-inspections, and make sure the handover documents and the Project Close-Out Report are complete.

**Skills and competencies**

* Good working knowledge of MS Project, plus MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Understands interior finishes, MEP services and how trades interface in fit-out work.
* Firm, clear stakeholder management; confident presenting to senior Client management.
* Organised and disciplined about documentation; raises problems early and brings a fix with them.

**Role boundaries**

* Does not take on design responsibility, quantity measurement or bill certification, or health & safety supervision. These are excluded under the appointment.

title: PMO Analyst, LAB49 Noida
description:
**About Lab49**
Lab49 is an award-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology solutions and products for the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002, Lab49 combines strategy, design, and technology expertise to deliver transformative outcomes for investment banks, asset managers, exchanges, and other capital markets participants.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Lab49 is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented PMO Analyst to support the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives. The PMO Analyst will play a key role in driving project governance, integrated planning, reporting, risk management, resource coordination, and delivery controls across complex programs.
  
  
This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical skills, and the ability to provide transparency into project performance, dependencies, risks, and milestones while supporting delivery teams and leadership.
  
  
“
**Success in this role means building a PMO that improves delivery outcomes, not simply administering governance activities”**
**Key Responsibilities**
**PMO Capability Building and Operating Model**

* Help design, establish, and mature a scalable PMO operating model covering governance, integrated planning, reporting, financial controls, resource management, risk management, and delivery assurance.
* Establish common delivery metrics and dashboards that give leadership a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, quality, and financial performance.
* Create reusable playbooks for discovery, mobilization, execution, release readiness, stabilization, and program closure.

**End-to-End Delivery Management**

* Support delivery from initial discovery and mobilization through planning, execution, release, stabilization, and closure.
* Maintain an end-to-end view across business, product, design, architecture, engineering, quality engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and operations.
* Identify sequencing issues, delivery gaps, conflicting priorities, and cross-team dependencies before they affect critical milestones.
* Drive ownership of actions and decisions, ensuring unresolved items are escalated with clear impact assessments and recommended options.
* Conduct delivery health checks, provide an independent evidence-based view of status, and support recovery planning for at-risk workstreams.
* Coordinate distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, functions, and partner organizations.

**AI-Enabled Delivery and PMO**

* Use approved AI capabilities to improve the speed and quality of planning, reporting, meeting synthesis, dependency analysis, knowledge retrieval, and management communications.
* Ensure AI use complies with firm’s confidentiality, data-protection, information-security, and responsible-use requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive PMO activities such as status consolidation, action tracking, document classification, and governance-pack preparation.

**Governance and Executive Communication**

* Prepare concise executive updates that clearly distinguish progress, risks, decisions required, implications, and recommended actions.
* Maintain accurate records of decisions, commitments, actions, and escalations.
* Prepare and maintain governance materials, status reports, steering committee packs, and executive dashboards.
* Monitor project progress against agreed milestones and provide delivery traceability and reporting.

**Integrated Planning, Risks, and Dependencies**

* Own or coordinate integrated planning across multiple workstreams and delivery organizations.
* Establish dependency-management practices that identify upstream and downstream impacts across product, technology, operations, and third parties.
* Facilitate RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management and ensure timely escalation of delivery risks and blockers.

**Financial, Commercial, and Resource Management**

* Support program budgeting, forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance analysis.
* Maintain visibility into team capacity, onboarding, allocation, role requirements, and forward demand.
* Connect resource plans with delivery milestones, critical skills, and workstream priorities.
* Support commercial tracking across statements of work, deliverables, milestones, change requests, and client commitments.
* Identify potential scope, timeline, or cost impacts early and support structured change-control discussions.
* Provide forward-looking views of capacity gaps and delivery constraints rather than relying only on retrospective reporting.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 7 years of experience in PMO, project governance, delivery management, program controls, or related technology-delivery roles.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning PMO workstreams and building or improving delivery-governance practices within complex technology programs.
* Experience with RAID management, integrated planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with global stakeholders in a fast-paced consulting environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting technology delivery programs within financial services, capital markets, banking, or fintech organizations.
* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience with financial tracking, resource planning, and executive reporting.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong attention to detail and execution excellence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A collaborative mindset with a focus on delivery outcomes.
* Data-driven decision-making and reporting capabilities.

**Information Security Responsibilities**

* Comply with all Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies, standards, and procedures.
* Protect confidential, client, and company information in accordance with Lab49 and ION security requirements.
* Promptly report security incidents, risks, or policy violations.
* Participate in mandatory security awareness and compliance training.
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory, contractual, and information security obligations.
