**Job Description Summary**
Responsible for activities related to the construction, building and commissioning on customer site, from site mobilization, through civil, erection and commissioning work, as well as management activities related to this scope. Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
  
  

* Execution of Mechanical erection works mainly related to rotating machines, Feed water pumps, Cooling pumps, Condensate extraction pumps, injection pumps, miscellaneous pumps –Driven pumps, blowers, fans, Compressors, control valves, etc, compliance with time schedule and to satisfactory quality. Coordination with the Construction lead, and mechanical commissioning engineers .
* In charge of maintenance, trouble shooting , reparation of pumps, over-hauling, pumps alignment, routine & preventive maintenance, oil filling, for all mechanicals equipment’s.
* Provide co-workers with information about hazards, risks and risk mitigation measures applicable to the site.

Ensuring within the scope of the discipline works that subcontractors are in compliance with the EHS requirements at the site.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
The role requires strong mechanical execution and site-management capability, including subcontractor/client management, claims, rental equipment and company assets, EHS reviews, site warehouse / material controls, financials and statutory compliance. The incumbent will also lead the mechanical construction team / Supervisors to deliver project targets.
  
  
**Main Tasks**

* The Mechanical Construction Manager is responsible for the performance of site activities within the scope of his field of expertise, which is mainly the rotating machines erection, maintenance, alignment, over-hauling, repair, trouble shooting, etc.
* Checking the assembly documentation for his mechanical equipment scope, as well as the O&M manuals.
* Checking the I&T plans for his field of expertise while including the I&T program.
* Full supervision, support and guidance of the team working under his authority
* Full erection and maintenance of Rotating machines in accordance with the applicable drawings ,and O & M manuals.
* Full implementation of EHS rules and directives.
* Full cooperation and coordination with SM and other supervisors .
* Implementation of the work schedule tasks and time lines.

**Detailed Tasks**

* Perform erection and maintenance of all pumps in Turbine hall such as Feedwater pumps, condensate extraction pumps, CCW pumps, ACW pumps, miscellaneous pumps, etc
* Perform erection and maintenance of all blowers, compressors, fans, and control valves.
* Perform all shaft / rotors alignments , and keep records according to ITPL
* Oversees assigned mechanical personnel and daily erection activities (e.g. training, scheduling, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring that assignments are completed in a safe, proper and timely manner and maximizing the efficiency of the workforce
* Prepare and brief his team on individual site jobs to ensure site work is carried out to a high standard.
* Ability in reading and understanding specifications, drawings, and all other related project and engineering documentation. Knowledge of power plant KKS system is an added advantage.
* Maintenance , over-haul , and repairs of mechanical systems like actuators, pumps, motors, valves, hydraulics, pneumatics, upon request of GEV commissioning, and erection lead.
* Walk downs and visual inspection of live systems while plant in operation. Equipment malfunctions, faults, leaks, noise, etc and reporting to the related responsible.
* Commissioning assistance for cleaning preparation, inspection, tools, and spare parts.
* Checking of availability of tools required for erection and maintenance.
* Keeps records of all work completed and completion of "Action Lists"
* Must be a good communicator. Able to give instructions in an efficient and effective way to his workforce.
* Liaises with other discipline foremen to ensure the optimum utilization of available work, with the overall objective of successful completion of the project.
* Familiar with all Company Safety and QA/QC procedures and strictly enforces them amongst the GEV / subcontractor workforce.
* Identifies, formulates and implements "on - the - job" training programs for the workforce under his responsibility in coordination with the supervisor.
* Supervise and/or perform mechanical tasks related to disassembly & reassembly, functional clearance checks , alignment check of all rotating equipment and including turbine shaft line.
* Ability to use and train his team on all type of accurate measurement tools.
* Ensure work permits and checks are completed to carry work out safely.
* Request equipment, materials and consumables as required with in limits of authority in coordination with the Turbine engineer.
* Should have experience on lifting and rigging .
* Monitor the use of materials and care of equipment to minimize waste and damage.
* Support Site Manager to Maintain a variety of files and records (e.g. time sheets, inventory, work orders, labor/material estimates, equipment, manuals, etc.)
* Knowledge of Rotating machines preservation during erection and assembly phase.
* Identification of mechanical equipment parts in package list and request as per site erection schedule.
* Assuring the quality of execution within the erection scope of the stipulated guidelines and the applicable instructions.
* Observation of the Regulations for Field Assembly and Commissioning Staff or the Site Instructions, respectively.
* Regular reports on his field of expertise according to the specifications
* Registration and forwarding of non-conformities .Report beyond the original scope of work in form of non-conformance reports (NCR).
* Read the drawing and preparing work sequence.
* Check the alignment and other parameters of turbine.
* Assistance to the commissioning group to trouble shooting during commissioning/synchronization.
* Inspect the various clearances measured in erected equipment’s.
* Give necessary correction to various activities coming under erection.
* Deploy man power for various activities of erection.
* Maintain all the documentation of erection equipment.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors of Engineering in Mechanical with overall Experience gained on the job during professional life – 10-12 years
* 3 to 4 years’ experience in the execution of FGD / Power projects for power plants

**Desirable (NICE TO HAVE)**

* Management experience of medium size multi-cultural technical team
* M & E Erection & Commissioning experience

Behavioral and/or Technical Know-how
  
  

* Feel responsible and lead by example
* Ability to organize his/her work to achieve the required results
* Ability to delegate, control and assume responsibility
* Committed to his/her responsibilities
* Ability to lead and motivate a design team
* Communication and team building faculties.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes
  
  

* This is a remote position

title: VP – Engineering & Technical Delivery
description:
**About Mirketa**

Mirketa is a U.S.-headquartered digital transformation, technology consulting, and product engineering company with a delivery center in Noida. We specialize in Salesforce, AI/GenAI, cloud platforms, data engineering, enterprise integration, and custom application development, and develop products serving healthcare, nonprofits, and other industries.

**Position Overview**

We seek a VP – Engineering & Technical Delivery to take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery across client services—from RFPs and solutioning to estimation, staffing, execution, portfolio governance, quality and delivery completion. This hands-on executive will lead Technical Delivery Directors, Technology Managers, Architects, Technical Leads, and engineering teams, while building strong program management capability and an accountable, high-performing culture.

Mandatory work location: This is a fully on-premises role at the Noida office. Daily physical presence during core business hours is required; hybrid and remote arrangements are not available.

1.
**Pre-Sales, RFPs & Solution Estimation**

* Own technical responses for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and new business pursuits; partner with U.S. sales and account teams.
* Lead architecture, technology selection, delivery approach, implementation strategy, and technical proposal presentations.
* Own project sizing, effort estimates, resource plans, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and achievable schedules.
* Standardize estimation using historical benchmarks; approve technical estimates and delivery models before commercial commitments.

2.
**End-to-End Technical Delivery**

* Own technical delivery outcomes across client engagements, from design and development through testing, deployment and stabilization.
* Lead Technical Delivery Directors and oversee execution through Technology Managers, Architects and Technical Leads.
* Ensure projects are properly planned, staffed and executed; resolve technical dependencies, bottlenecks and delivery risks.
* Lead technical escalation response and troubled-project recovery; improve execution efficiency and reliability.

3.
**Portfolio Governance & Program Management**

* Lead weekly project and portfolio reviews covering milestones, progress, schedules, effort consumption, budgets, risks, quality and commitments.
* Build strong program management practices through a Program Delivery Director, Project Managers and Business Analysts.
* Enforce reliable project plans, forecasts, RAID logs, status reporting, change control and corrective action tracking.
* Provide executive visibility into project health and ensure proactive risk identification, escalation and resolution.

4.
**Engineering Quality & Architecture Governance**

* Own architecture reviews, technical design approvals, engineering standards, code reviews and delivery quality gates.
* Establish effective automated testing, CI/CD, security, performance, release management and defect-prevention practices.
* Measure escaped defects, rework, test automation, technical debt and reliability; lead root-cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Promote scalable and maintainable designs, reference architectures, and reusable components.

5.
**Delivery Economics, Resource Planning & Productivity**

* Own technical effort budgets, engineering capacity, staffing effectiveness and delivery productivity.
* Monitor estimates versus actual effort, utilization, delivery costs and forecasts; partner with Finance on margins.
* Improve delivery economics through accurate estimates, skill-based staffing, automation and lower rework.

6.
**Talent Acquisition, Hiring & Workforce Development**

* Own the hiring of technical and program management talent at ALL levels, including junior and mid-level engineers, senior specialists, architects, Technical Leads, Engineering Managers, Project Managers, Business Analysts and Directors.
* Personally lead assessment and selection of senior engineering, technical delivery and program management leaders.
* Develop workforce plans, competency requirements, interview standards, technical assessments, hiring pipelines and onboarding expectations with HR/Talent Acquisition.
* Build hiring pipelines across Salesforce, Python/AI, cloud, data engineering, QA, DevOps and program delivery; evaluate both technical ability and leadership potential.
* Use professional networks, referrals and industry relationships to attract strong mid-to-senior technical and program talent, when available.
* Improve quality of hire, talent readiness, internal promotions, retention, and succession planning.

7.
**Leadership Development & Culture**

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Delivery Directors, the Program Delivery Director, Engineering Managers, Architects, Technical Leads and program professionals.
* Establish clear role accountabilities, performance expectations and manager effectiveness standards.
* Partner with HR on individual development plans, regular 1:1s, mentoring, performance reviews and talent retention.
* Build a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing merit, ownership, innovation, transparency and continuous learning.

8.
**Engineering Capability Development & Innovation**

* Strengthen Salesforce, Python, AI/GenAI, Azure/AWS, data engineering and enterprise integration competencies.
* Build appropriate Centers of Excellence, reusable frameworks, technical training and certification paths.
* Drive practical AI-assisted engineering, automated tests and modern practices; develop understanding of agents, RAG, MCP and LLM integration.
* Support product engineering with shared architecture standards and engineering best practices.

9.
**Client Engagement & Escalation Management**

* Act as a senior technical executive in strategic client meetings, architecture reviews and critical escalations.
* Partner with U.S. stakeholders to align scope, schedules, commitments and technical execution.
* Support satisfaction, retention, account growth and technically credible new-business pursuits.

**Required Qualifications**

• 18+ years in software engineering, solution architecture and technical delivery, including 7+ years in senior engineering or technical delivery leadership.

• Prior hands-on engineering and architecture experience; strong Salesforce background preferred, with enterprise integration, cloud and DevOps knowledge.

• Experience leading approximately 100–300 technical professionals and multiple concurrent complex enterprise programs.

• Demonstrated accountability for RFPs, pre-sales solutioning, estimates, project portfolio execution, delivery economics and quality.

• Demonstrated success recruiting technical and program management talent at junior, mid, senior and leadership levels.

• Proven ability to develop managers, architects, Technical Leads, Project Managers and program delivery leaders.

• Working knowledge of AI/GenAI, Python, cloud and modern data engineering; strong communication with North American clients.

• Ability and willingness to work from the Noida office every working day during core hours.

• Leadership in a mid-sized IT services, Salesforce consulting or digital engineering business.

• Experience with enterprise SaaS, healthcare technology or AI-enabled solutions.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

• Established professional network and demonstrated ability to bring strong mid-to-senior technical talent—including Directors, Architects, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads and specialist Salesforce, AI, cloud and data engineers—into an organization.

**Key Performanc Metrics for first 180 Days**

**Days 1–30 — Assess and launch recruitment**

• Assess portfolio health, delivery structure, talent, managers, architecture quality, estimation and project risks.

• Establish delivery and quality baselines and agree accountability, competency requirements and recruitment strategy for three Technical Delivery Directors and one Program Delivery Director.

**Days 31–90 — Establish control and accelerate hiring**

• Implement weekly portfolio reviews, architecture governance, sizing practices, project health reporting and performance expectations.

• Lead sourcing, assessment, interviews and selection for the four Director-level roles; initiate recovery actions on at-risk projects.

• Meet client stakeholders and create account plan for all key accounts

**Days 91–180 — Deliver leadership team and measurable progress**

• Successfully hire and onboard THREE Technical Delivery Directors and ONE Program Delivery Director by day 180.

• Assign clear portfolios, reporting accountabilities, performance measures and operating routines to newly hired Directors.

• Demonstrate improvements in delivery predictability, engineering quality, manager effectiveness, technical hiring pipeline and governance.

**Compensation:**
As per experience

**Location:**
Noida (no remote)

title: Curriculum Operations Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Curriculum Operations Senior Associate**
Position Summary
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate (India) works as part of the Audit Learning Strategy team, and closely with the Learning Design team, business unit subject matter experts, and other Development & Performance team members to support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Audit learning curriculum.
  
  
This individual serves as a key operational partner responsible for executing curriculum management processes, coordinating learning asset updates, and ensuring learning content remains current, compliant, and accessible. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, project coordination capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a large and complex curriculum portfolio.
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate plays a critical role in supporting Audit learning initiatives by managing curriculum and learning design lifecycle activities, coordinating annual content reviews, maintaining learning assets, supporting live learning programs, and ensuring compliance with firm and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Learning Design Lifecycle
  
  

* Partner directly with the design team to manage eLearning lifecycle activities, monitoring progress against established timelines and ensuring work advances in alignment with the team’s priorities.
* Maintain tracking tools to ensure eLearning portfolio and pipeline remain current and aligned with business priorities.
* Execute recurring curriculum management processes, including coordinating course updates, deactivations, closedowns, conversions, and archive activities.
* Coordinate annual review activities by initiating review cycles, tracking progress, communicating with subject matter experts, and documenting required changes.
* Validate course updates, assessments, answer keys, and supporting materials prior to publication.
* Manage eLearning session uploads and updates within learning systems and associated platforms.
* Support the administration of non-CPE learning content, including recording management, SCORM conversions, and learning playlists.
* Ensure curriculum materials are accurate, accessible, organized, and aligned with established standards.

Compliance Assurance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with and documentation of NASBA, AICPA, and internal Crowe standards.
* Coordinate technical reviews and required approvals with subject matter experts and stakeholders.
* Conduct compliance quality assurance reviews of learning materials, review and final exam questions, and supporting resources.
* Maintain documentation supporting compliance and curriculum governance processes.

Learning Program Support
  
  

* Maintain and update participant-facing materials, including agendas, surveys, and resource pages.
* Maintain and update SharePoint sites and learning resource repositories.
* Support Audit learning program preparation and post-event activities.
* Conduct testing and support quality reviews of learning sites, course environments, and learner experiences.
* Coordinate with learning delivery, design, and technology teams to support successful program execution.

Project Coordination and Operational Support
  
  

* Coordinate curriculum management activities across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and action plans.
* Partner with internal learning teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Escalate risks, delays, or issues that may impact project timelines or learner experience.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline curriculum management processes and improve operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with Audit subject matter experts.
* Communicate eLearning project status, upcoming deadlines, review requirements, and curriculum updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with learning strategy, design, technology, and program delivery teams to support curriculum initiatives.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong curriculum management and learning operations experience.
* Excellent organizational and project coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience maintaining complex learning portfolios and curriculum records.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
* Ability to support learning projects and assets with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to develop and edit content according to specific clients’ needs.
* Commitment to process improvement and operational excellence.
* Working knowledge of instructional design principles and eLearning technologies, such as Articulate 360, and an interest in expanding hands-on design and development capabilities.
* Proficiency in using project management tools, such as Microsoft Office applications and SharePoint, to track and communicate project status, issues, and risk.
* Experience with SharePoint and Microsoft Office applications, from design, formatting, and functionality lens to create elevated learner experiences.

**General Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in learning and development, curriculum administration, learning operations, program coordination, or related fields.
* Experience supporting large-scale learning curricula, eLearning or learning programs.
* Experience with the practical application of instructional design and adult learning theory to help guide and support our design team to deliver visually compelling solutions and provide a rewarding experience for the learner.
* Experience working in a professional services environment preferred.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and managing multiple stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications, SharePoint, project management tools, and learning technologies.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Program Manager
description:
We are seeking a results-driven and strategic Program Manager – Lead Generation & Sales to design, execute, and scale our end-to-end lead generation and sales enablement programs. In this role, you will bridge the gap between marketing demand generation and outbound execution. You will manage cross-functional workflows, track pipeline metrics, optimize conversion funnels, and lead a team of specialists to meet aggressive revenue targets.

**Responsibilities**

* **Program Strategy & Execution:**
  Design and implement comprehensive outbound generation programs aligned with company/client revenue goals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with ERP and Partners, Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), Account Executives (AEs), and Sales Ops to define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and targeted outreach campaigns.
* **Pipeline & Data Analytics:**
  Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs)—including lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and quota attainment.
* **Team Leadership & Coaching:**
  Manage, mentor, and scale a team of lead generation/sales support specialists or project contributors, driving daily activity and performance accountability.
* **Tech Stack & Process Optimization:**
  Oversee the utilization and integration of lead generation tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo Zntlr etc).
* **Sales Enablement & Training:**
  Develop playbooks, scripts, email sequences, and training materials to continuously improve outreach effectiveness.
* Ensure high quality work is produced
* Anticipate and solve any problems related to the program
* Conduct performance reviews and evaluate program
* Facilitate communication between relevant teams

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, IT or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4–6+ years of combined experience in IT program management, sales operations, B2B lead generation, or B2B sales development.
* Proven track record of scaling pipeline generation and hitting commercial targets in a fast-paced environment.
* Technical Proficiency: Deep familiarity with ERP platforms and lead intelligence/prospecting tools.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong data-analysis skills (Excel, BI dashboards) to segment data, forecast trends, and evaluate campaign ROI.
* Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategies to executive leadership.

description:

:

description:
**Company Description**
TOYOTA TSUSHO Nexty Electronics India Private Limited is the India arm of NEXTY Electronics, a 100% subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho, a major general trading company in Japan. Established in April 2000 in India, the company specializes in local distribution of electrical components and delivers stable production support through a robust supply chain. Building on decades of expertise in electronics, NEXTY Electronics provides comprehensive one-stop solutions, including system solutions, bespoke software development, and connected solutions for logistics and fleet management. The company collaborates with partner EMS providers for production services and is committed to quality service and innovative, customer-focused solutions.

**Role Description**
A Senior Embedded Software Manager –PMSM Motor Control leads the design, development, and team execution of firmware, control algorithms, and software architectures for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) & it’s related peripherals, communications etc. This role spans automotive traction/Motor drives, industrial automation systems, and high-volume consumer appliances.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Architecture: Define end-to-end embedded software and system architectures for 3-phase PMSM motor control Electronic Control Units (ECUs), industrial drives, and appliance control boards.
* Algorithm & Control Design: Oversee implementation of Field-Oriented Control (FOC), maximum torque per ampere (MTPA), field-weakening, sensorless/sensored commutation, and advanced observers.
* Application Scope Strategy: Drive software engineering for diverse applications including EV traction drives, automotive thermal management (electronic water pumps, cooling fans), industrial servo drives, and consumer motor control applications like air conditioning compressor controls.
* People & Program Management: Lead, mentor, and scale cross-functional embedded software and motor-control engineering teams. Handle sprint planning, milestone tracking, and cross-department collaboration.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure adherence to industry safety and quality standards, managing software lifecycles compliant as per industry needs e.g. ISO 26262 (Automotive ASIL), IEC 61508 (Industrial), IEC 60730 (Consumer Safety), ASPICE, and MISRA C guidelines.
* Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with power electronics, inverter hardware, and systems engineering for debugging, HIL/SIL/MIL validation, and motor dynamometer testing.

title: Head of Planning
description:
**CRC Group**
is dedicated to redefining real estate in Noida and beyond by delivering uniquely tailored luxury residential and commercial spaces. We prioritize innovative design, sustainability, and precision, ensuring every project reflects our commitment to excellence. At CRC, we strive to create personalized environments that align with our clients' visions and aspirations. Our mission is to build spaces that add value, inspire, and create enduring legacies.

We are looking for an experienced and strategic
**Head – Planning**
to lead project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and project controls for high-rise residential and commercial real estate developments.

The candidate will be responsible for developing comprehensive project schedules, monitoring construction progress, identifying critical delays, forecasting resource requirements, and implementing recovery plans to ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines and budgets.

The ideal candidate should have
**20+ years of experience**
in construction planning and project controls, with substantial exposure to
**high-rise residential and commercial projects.**
Strong expertise in Primavera P6, critical path analysis, resource planning, contractor schedule management, and management-level reporting is essential.

The role requires close coordination with construction, design, procurement, contracts, billing, and project management teams to ensure effective planning, timely decision-making, and successful project delivery.

**Designation:**
Head – Planning

**Department:**
Planning & Project Controls

**Experience:**
20+ Years

**Industry:**
Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure

**Location:**
Noida, NCR

**Reporting To:**
Management

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategic Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and implement the overall planning and project controls framework for high-rise residential and commercial projects.
* Prepare master project schedules covering design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Establish project milestones, key deliverables, critical activities, and completion targets in alignment with management objectives.
* Develop detailed baseline schedules, phase-wise construction programmes, and milestone-based execution plans.
* Integrate civil, structural, MEP, façade, finishing, external development, and other construction activities into comprehensive project schedules.
* Establish standard planning methodologies, reporting formats, scheduling protocols, and project control systems across projects.

**B. Project Monitoring & Progress Control**

* Monitor actual progress against approved baseline schedules and identify deviations, delays, and critical bottlenecks.
* Conduct regular reviews of project progress, critical path activities, milestone achievement, and schedule performance.
* Analyse delays and their root causes, assess their impact on project completion, and recommend corrective measures.
* Develop catch-up schedules and recovery plans in coordination with construction teams and contractors.
* Validate physical progress reported by project sites against measurable work quantities and approved progress parameters.
* Track key milestones, pending activities, design dependencies, approvals, and procurement constraints affecting project timelines.

**C. Contractor Planning & Coordination**

* Review and evaluate construction contractors' baseline schedules, detailed work programmes, and resource deployment plans.
* Ensure contractor schedules are aligned with the overall project master programme and contractual milestones.
* Monitor contractor-wise progress, manpower deployment, equipment availability, productivity, and planned versus actual performance.
* Identify underperformance and work with construction and contract management teams to establish time-bound corrective action plans.
* Review contractor delay claims, extension-of-time submissions, and schedule-related contractual matters in coordination with contracts and project teams.
* Drive regular planning reviews with project heads, construction teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure accountability for delivery commitments.

**D. Project Controls & Risk Management**

* Establish robust project control mechanisms for schedule tracking, progress measurement, milestone reporting, and variance analysis.
* Identify potential schedule risks arising from design changes, approvals, procurement delays, contractor performance, and resource constraints.
* Conduct critical path analysis, float analysis, what-if scenarios, and schedule impact assessments.
* Develop early-warning systems to identify risks to project completion and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain project risk registers and track mitigation plans in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Support management in evaluating the schedule impact of changes in scope, construction methodology, and project priorities.

**E. Resource Planning & Optimisation**

* Develop project-wise and phase-wise manpower, machinery, and resource requirement plans.
* Assess resource availability against construction schedules and identify resource gaps affecting execution.
* Coordinate with construction, procurement, and contractor teams to align resource deployment with project priorities.
* Analyse construction productivity and identify opportunities to improve resource utilisation and execution efficiency.
* Support cash flow and expenditure forecasting by providing time-phased project progress and resource inputs.
* Recommend sequencing and execution strategies to optimise project duration and resource deployment.

**F. Design, Procurement & Construction Integration**

* Coordinate with design and technical teams to track drawing releases, design approvals, and resolution of technical dependencies.
* Integrate procurement schedules with construction programmes to ensure timely availability of critical materials and equipment.
* Track long-lead items, material submittals, vendor approvals, and delivery milestones.
* Monitor interdependencies between civil, structural, MEP, façade, finishing, and other project packages.
* Ensure alignment between design deliverables, procurement activities, contractor mobilisation, and site execution.
* Highlight constraints and escalate critical issues that may impact project milestones.

**G. Management Reporting & Decision Support**

* Prepare periodic management dashboards, project progress reports, milestone trackers, and schedule variance analyses.
* Present project-wise performance, critical path issues, completion forecasts, and recovery plans to management.
* Provide reliable forecasts for project completion dates based on actual progress, outstanding work, and identified risks.
* Highlight critical decisions, resource requirements, and management interventions necessary to protect project timelines.
* Establish standardised KPIs and reporting mechanisms across all projects.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to support management decisions on project priorities, resource allocation, and execution strategies.

**H. Team Leadership & Process Improvement**

* Lead and mentor project planning managers, senior planners, planning engineers, and project controls professionals.
* Establish clear responsibilities, performance standards, and reporting structures within the planning function.
* Standardise planning processes, progress measurement systems, and schedule review mechanisms across projects.
* Build planning capability within project teams and strengthen coordination between planning and execution functions.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analytics, digital planning tools, and systematic performance reviews.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering is mandatory.
* Master's degree in Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Minimum
  **20+ years of experience**
  in construction planning, project scheduling, and project controls.
* Significant experience in high-rise residential and/or commercial real estate projects.
* Proven experience in developing and managing integrated master schedules for large-scale construction projects.
* Strong exposure to contractor planning, schedule reviews, critical path analysis, delay management, and recovery planning.
* Experience in management-level reporting and presenting project performance to senior leadership.
* Experience with established real estate developers, EPC organisations, or large construction companies is preferred.

**Technical Skills & Expertise**

* Advanced proficiency in
  **Primavera P6**
  and strong working knowledge of MS Project.
* Expertise in baseline scheduling, WBS development, critical path method, float analysis, and schedule forecasting.
* Strong understanding of high-rise construction sequences, including basements, foundations, RCC structures, MEP, façade, finishing, and handover.
* Knowledge of resource loading, productivity analysis, progress measurement, and earned value management.
* Ability to analyse project delays, prepare recovery schedules, and assess time impacts of variations.
* Strong skills in Excel, project dashboards, data analysis, and management reporting.
* Familiarity with BIM-based planning, 4D scheduling, and digital project controls is an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and strong analytical capabilities.
* Excellent planning, scheduling, and project control expertise.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to identify risks proactively and drive timely corrective action.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in forecasting and reporting.
* Strong leadership and team development capabilities.
* Ability to influence project teams and contractors without direct operational control.
* High ownership, accountability, and commitment to project delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Adherence to approved project baseline schedules and key milestones.
* Accuracy of project completion forecasts.
* Timely identification and escalation of schedule risks.
* Effectiveness of recovery plans and delay mitigation.
* Reliability of contractor schedules and progress reporting.
* Timeliness and accuracy of management dashboards and reports.
* Integration of design, procurement, and construction schedules.
* Improvement in planning processes, schedule visibility, and project controls.
* Timely completion of project activities supporting testing, commissioning, and handover.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a seasoned planning professional with strong expertise in high-rise residential or commercial construction, capable of managing planning and project controls across multiple projects. The candidate should combine advanced scheduling capabilities with a practical understanding of construction execution, contractor performance, procurement dependencies, and project risks.

The individual must be comfortable presenting project performance directly to management, providing realistic completion forecasts, identifying critical interventions, and driving accountability across project stakeholders.

title: Data Center PMS - Project Technical Lead
description:

You will lead the engineering, development, integration, testing, and commissioning of advanced Data Center PMS/ECMS solutions for AI-ready, mission-critical facilities with onsite generation and complex electrical distribution systems.
  
  

* Review customer specifications, SLDs, protection schemes, AI workload profiles, generator operating philosophy, and power management requirements.
* Design PMS/ECMS architectures, DCS control strategies, network topologies, and system integration approaches for high-density data center electrical infrastructure.
* Develop, configure, and tune Ovation DCS databases, control logic, graphics, alarms, trends, displays, and operator interfaces for PMS applications.
* Engineer advanced load management functions including AI peak demand control, priority-based load shedding, load restoration, load sharing, islanding, black start, bus transfer, and demand management.
* Develop complex load bus management schemes for multiple electrical buses, generators, transformers, switchgear lineups, UPS/BESS interfaces, and critical/non-critical load groups.
* Engineer and validate multi-generator synchronization, load sharing, generator sequencing, spinning reserve logic, and transitions between grid-connected, islanded, and backup operating modes.
* Integrate generators, switchgear, substations, transformers, protective relays, RTACs, meters, UPS, BESS, renewable energy systems, and utility/grid interfaces.
* Configure and troubleshoot IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, and related communication protocols used for power system automation and electrical asset integration.
* Prepare engineering deliverables including PMS philosophy, FDS, logic narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, I/O lists, communication documents, simulation plans, and test procedures.
* Execute simulation, FAT, SAT, system integration, commissioning, startup, performance tuning, and customer acceptance testing for PMS/ECMS systems.
* Lead system power-up, redundancy testing, communication verification, functional testing, failure-mode testing, and validation of electrical operating scenarios.
* Coordinate with customers, consultants, vendors, project teams, and subcontractors while ensuring compliance with project requirements, quality standards, industry codes, and mission-critical uptime expectations.

title: Project Head
description:
**CRC Group**
is dedicated to redefining real estate in Noida and beyond by delivering uniquely tailored luxury residential and commercial spaces. We prioritize innovative design, sustainability, and precision, ensuring every project reflects our commitment to excellence. At CRC, we strive to create personalized environments that align with our clients' visions and aspirations. Our mission is to build spaces that add value, inspire, and create enduring legacies.

We are looking for an experienced
**construction leader**
to
**head the execution of high-rise residential and commercial real estate projects**
. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, including construction planning, execution, contractor management, quality control, cost optimisation, safety, and timely completion.

The ideal candidate should have
**20+ years**
of experience in high-rise construction, preferably with leading real estate developers, and a strong track record of managing multiple contractors, construction agencies, and specialist vendors across large-scale projects.

This role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, execution discipline, and the ability to drive contractors and project teams to deliver projects in line with approved drawings, specifications, budgets, quality standards, and committed timelines.

**Designation:**
Site Head – High-Rise Residential / Commercial Projects

**Department:**
Projects / Construction

**Experience:**
20+ Years

**Industry:**
Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure

**Location:**
Noida, NCR

**Reporting To:**
President – Construction

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Execution & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end construction execution of high-rise residential and commercial projects, from mobilisation through completion and handover.
* Develop project execution strategies, construction methodologies, resource plans, and milestone-based schedules.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects in accordance with approved budgets, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.
* Monitor construction progress against baseline schedules, identify critical path delays, and implement corrective action plans.
* Review construction progress across civil, structural, finishing, façade, MEP, and allied works.
* Drive coordination between project sites, design teams, consultants, and corporate management.

**B. Contractor & Contract Management**

* Lead the selection, onboarding, mobilisation, and performance management of construction contractors and specialist agencies.
* Manage multiple contractors across civil, structural, finishing, façade, MEP, waterproofing, and other construction packages.
* Establish clear scopes of work, contractual deliverables, construction milestones, and performance benchmarks for contractors.
* Review contractor work programmes, manpower deployment, equipment availability, productivity, and execution quality.
* Conduct regular contractor review meetings to monitor progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure accountability for deliverables.
* Manage contractual issues, work certifications, variations, claims, extensions of time, and dispute resolution in coordination with commercial and contracts teams.
* Enforce contractual obligations and take timely corrective action in case of poor performance, delays, or quality deviations.
* Drive contractor productivity, resource optimisation, and cost efficiency without compromising quality or safety.

**C. Planning, Monitoring & Project Controls**

* Oversee preparation and implementation of detailed project schedules, construction programmes, and resource plans.
* Monitor project milestones, critical activities, procurement dependencies, and construction productivity.
* Review weekly and monthly progress reports, identify deviations, and establish recovery plans.
* Ensure effective coordination between planning, billing, procurement, design, contracts, and site execution teams.
* Forecast resource requirements and anticipate risks that could affect project delivery.
* Provide periodic project performance reports, risks, and escalation points to the President – Construction.

**D. Cost Control & Commercial Management**

* Drive construction cost optimisation and ensure execution within approved project budgets.
* Monitor project expenditure, contractor bills, variations, material consumption, and cost-to-complete forecasts.
* Review contractor measurements, running account bills, and work completion certifications with relevant teams.
* Identify opportunities for value engineering, construction productivity improvement, and waste reduction.
* Coordinate with procurement and contracts teams to ensure timely availability of materials and services.
* Control cost overruns arising from delays, rework, inefficient deployment, and scope changes.

**E. Quality Assurance & Technical Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with approved architectural, structural, MEP, and construction drawings and specifications.
* Establish and monitor quality control procedures, inspection plans, testing protocols, and workmanship standards.
* Review mock-ups, method statements, inspection and test plans, and material approvals.
* Ensure timely closure of quality observations, non-conformities, and construction defects.
* Drive preventive measures to minimise rework, material wastage, and post-handover defects.
* Coordinate with design consultants and technical teams to resolve site-level engineering and constructability issues.

**F. Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure strict adherence to site safety standards, statutory requirements, and applicable construction regulations.
* Drive implementation of EHS systems, contractor safety compliance, toolbox talks, and regular site safety audits.
* Identify and mitigate construction, contractual, technical, and operational risks.
* Ensure appropriate permits, inspections, testing, and statutory approvals are coordinated with the relevant teams.
* Promote a strong safety culture across employees, contractors, subcontractors, and site personnel.

**G. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead project heads, construction managers, project managers, planning engineers, quality teams, and site execution teams.
* Establish clear accountability, performance standards, and reporting mechanisms across projects.
* Coordinate with the President – Construction, architects, consultants, procurement, finance, contracts, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project reviews and drive timely resolution of critical execution issues.
* Build a performance-oriented culture focused on ownership, collaboration, productivity, and timely delivery.
* Mentor project teams and strengthen construction management systems and processes.

**H. Project Completion & Handover**

* Drive project close-out, testing and commissioning, snag rectification, and completion documentation.
* Ensure coordination with CRM, facility management, and other relevant teams for smooth handover.
* Monitor closure of contractor punch lists, pending works, and outstanding contractual obligations.
* Ensure delivery of completed projects in accordance with approved specifications, statutory requirements, and handover commitments.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering is mandatory; a Master's degree in Construction Management or a relevant discipline is preferred.
* Minimum
  **20+ years of experience**
  in construction and project execution within the real estate or construction industry.
* Significant experience in executing high-rise residential and/or commercial buildings.
* Proven experience leading large-scale construction projects from mobilisation to completion and handover.
* Strong hands-on experience in
  **managing multiple contractors and subcontractors**
  , including contract administration, progress monitoring, productivity, billing, quality, and performance management.
* Experience working with established real estate developers or reputed construction organisations is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large project teams, complex construction interfaces, budgets, and demanding delivery timelines.
* Strong knowledge of civil and structural construction, MEP coordination, façade, finishing, construction planning, and project controls.

**Key Technical Competencies**

* High-rise construction methodologies, including RCC structures, basements, foundations, and vertical transportation coordination.
* Construction planning, scheduling, critical path analysis, and progress monitoring.
* Contractor management, tender evaluation, contract administration, and claims management.
* BOQ, rate analysis, quantity surveying, billing, cost control, and value engineering.
* Quality assurance, testing, inspection, and construction safety management.
* Working knowledge of Primavera P6, MS Project, AutoCAD, and project reporting tools.
* Understanding of applicable building codes, statutory approvals, and construction compliance requirements.

**Key Leadership Competencies**

* Strong execution-oriented leadership and decision-making.
* Excellent contractor negotiation and performance management skills.
* Commercial awareness and cost-conscious project management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder management and escalation-handling capabilities.
* High ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivery.
* Ability to lead teams under demanding project timelines while maintaining quality and safety standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Adherence to approved project schedules and committed completion dates.
* Construction cost performance against approved budgets.
* Contractor productivity and adherence to contractual milestones.
* Quality performance, defect rates, and reduction in rework.
* Safety performance and compliance with EHS requirements.
* Timely closure of project issues, claims, and contractor deliverables.
* Timely completion of testing, commissioning, and project handover.
* Effective resource utilisation and construction process improvement.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate will be a senior construction professional with extensive experience in high-rise residential or commercial real estate projects and a proven ability to deliver projects through effective contractor management. The candidate must be hands-on in construction execution, commercially strong, technically sound, and capable of driving multiple project teams and contractors towards timely, cost-effective, and quality-driven delivery.

title: SAP TM-Manager
description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Advisory – SAP TM Functional Manager:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The SAP TM Transportation Management Senior Consultant serves as a senior-level advisor responsible for leading complex SAP Transportation Management (TM) transformation initiatives for enterprise clients. This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support
* Risk management, issue resolution, and proactive communication to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Engineering or MBA in Supply Chain Area.
* Desired to have SAP certification on SAP TM.
* Having experience of working in integration area of SAP TM and other areas.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP TM.

**What We Look For**
**What we offer you**

*Rights & Royalties Transformation | IC20 | 3-4*

**Role Focus**

  
  

**Primary Platforms**

  
  

**Success Measure**

Agent creation, workflow automation and process transformation

  
  

Copilot Studio, Power Automate, M365 ecosystem; BI/data tools as enabling skills

  
  

Efficiency gains, cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption and controls

  
  

Rights, royalties, licensing, finance operations and publishing

  
  

**Role Summary**

  
  

We are seeking a high-impact Business Transformation Analyst to help modernise the Rights & Royalties operating model through AI-enabled agents, workflow automation, process simplification and measurable efficiency gains. This role is designed for someone who can understand operational pain points quickly, convert them into practical automation opportunities, and deliver adoption-ready solutions that improve speed, quality, control and stakeholder experience.

  
  

The ideal candidate combines structured business analysis with a maker mindset: able to map processes, define requirements, build low-code/agentic solutions, partner with technology teams, and track outcomes through clear KPIs. Hands-on data capability remains important, but the emphasis is on using data, AI and automation to transform recurring operational work, not on deep engineering or specialist BI development.

  
  

Royalties, rights, licensing, finance operations, publishing/media or revenue-share experience will be a strong advantage, particularly where it supports understanding of contracts, statements, payments, deductions, reserves, exceptions, approvals and audit sensitivity.

  
  

**Key Objectives - What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Create practical AI agents and guided automations that reduce manual effort, improve response quality and accelerate decision-making across Rights & Royalties operations.
  
  
* Simplify and standardise recurring workflows such as exception triage, approvals, reconciliations, case routing, notifications, quality checks and reporting packs.
  
  
* Deliver measurable efficiency gains through cycle-time reduction, lower rework, improved SLA performance, better adoption and stronger process controls.
  
  
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and adoption plans.
  
  
* Enable operational leaders with concise, self-serve visibility into risks, bottlenecks, productivity, quality and customer impact.
  

  

**Core Responsibilities**

  
  

**1) Process Transformation & Business Analysis**

  

  
* Conduct rapid discovery of current-state processes, pain points, root causes, handoffs, control gaps and duplication across Rights, Royalties and related Finance Operations.
  
  
* Design future-state workflows using a transformation lens: Simplify -> Standardise -> Automate -> Augment with AI -> Scale.
  
  
* Convert business needs into crisp requirements, user stories, process maps, acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
* Prioritise opportunities based on effort, impact, control risk, adoption readiness and efficiency potential.
  
  
* Support UAT, adoption, change communication, training aids and post-launch benefit tracking.
  

  

**2) Agent Creation & AI-enabled Solutions**

  

  
* Help design, configure and improve business-facing agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  
  
* Translate operational use cases into agent capabilities such as document review support, answer retrieval, exception explanation, guided decisioning, case summarisation and next-best-action recommendations.
  
  
* Define agent knowledge sources, prompts/instructions, guardrails, escalation paths, testing scenarios, success metrics and adoption feedback loops.
  
  
* Partner with technology, governance and business stakeholders to ensure agents are controlled, explainable, secure, measurable and fit for production use.
  
  
* Identify where agents should be combined with workflows, for example where AI reasoning is needed within a structured approval, triage or notification process.
  

  

**3) Workflow Automation & Operational Enablement**

  

  
* Build or support low-code automations using Power Automate, Copilot Studio workflows and connected Microsoft 365 services.
  
  
* Automate high-volume, rule-led and repeatable activities including validations, approvals, reminders, case routing, exception logging, report refreshes and stakeholder notifications.
  
  
* Design automations with appropriate audit trails, handoffs, fallback logic, approval controls, ownership and maintainability.
  
  
* Work with operations teams to ensure automation is embedded into daily routines rather than remaining as a standalone tool.
  

  

**4) Insights, KPIs & Benefit Realisation**

  

  
* Define outcome-led KPI frameworks for automation and process transformation, focused on hours saved, cycle time, quality, SLA, adoption, controls and customer impact.
  
  
* Use dashboards and reporting tools to monitor transformation outcomes, bottlenecks, adoption and benefit delivery.
  
  
* Perform practical analysis to identify trends, anomalies and improvement opportunities related to royalty statements, adjustments, disputes, metadata, reserves, payments or case volumes.
  
  
* Prepare concise executive-ready summaries that convert analysis into business decisions and action plans.
  

  

**5) Governance, Controls & Documentation**

  

  
* Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, decision logs, control points, KPI definitions and adoption materials.
  
  
* Ensure automation and agent assets have clear ownership, change control, traceability, testing evidence and governance alignment.
  
  
* Strengthen audit readiness through reconciliation checkpoints, exception logs, approval matrices and documented process logic.
  

  

**Typical Outcomes / KPIs You May Own**

  

  
* Automation and agent benefit realisation: hours saved, cost avoidance, productivity uplift and reduced manual touchpoints.
  
  
* Cycle-time and SLA improvement across targeted royalty, rights, finance operations or query-management workflows.
  
  
* Reduction in rework, avoidable escalations, duplicate handling, leakage risk and control exceptions.
  
  
* Agent and automation adoption: active users, usage frequency, completion rate, deflection rate, satisfaction and feedback themes.
  
  
* Quality and reliability: successful workflow runs, exception rates, data accuracy, audit trail completeness and refresh reliability.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  

  
* 3-4 years experience in a Business Analyst, Transformation Analyst, Automation Analyst, Process Analyst, Product Operations or comparable role.
  
  
* Strong process discovery and problem-solving capability, with the ability to simplify complex operational work into clear, actionable requirements.
  
  
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, preferably Power Automate and Copilot Studio, or a demonstrable ability to build low-code automations and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
* Ability to define agent or automation use cases, map workflows, document requirements, test outputs, manage feedback and support adoption.
  
  
* Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Finance, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance or Legal stakeholders.
  
  
* Good analytical capability and comfort working with operational data, KPIs and dashboards. Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, BigQuery or similar tools is useful, but not the primary focus of the role.
  
  
* Excellent communication skills: concise documentation, clear visuals, executive-ready summaries and practical training materials.
  
  
* Outcome ownership and delivery pace: able to move from discovery to MVP to adoption with discipline and urgency.
  

  

**Preferred / Advantageous**

  

  
* Exposure to royalties, rights, licensing, publishing/media, revenue-share, finance operations or contract-driven processes.
  
  
* Understanding of the royalty lifecycle: contract terms, rate structures, deductions, reserves, statements, payments, recoupment, audit queries and dispute handling.
  
  
* Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, Teams, Excel-based operations, document repositories or workflow-heavy operational environments.
  
  
* Familiarity with process mapping tools such as Blueworks, Visio or Lucidchart; Lean, continuous improvement or process re-engineering methods.
  
  
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, access control, knowledge-source hygiene and governance considerations for enterprise agents.
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business, Operations, IT, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  
  
* Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, PG Diploma in Business Analytics, Operations, Finance or Transformation is a differentiator, not mandatory.
  
  
* Relevant certifications in Power Platform, Copilot Studio, automation, business analysis, Lean/process improvement, data analytics or BI are advantageous.
  

  

**Behavioural**
**Competencies - Non-negotiable for Transformation**

  

  
* Agentic mindset: thinks beyond reporting and looks for ways to remove, automate or augment work.
  
  
* Adaptability, speed and agility:moves quickly from ambiguity to working MVPs and iterates based on feedback.
  
  
* Outcome ownership: focuses on measurable improvement, not activity completion.
  
  
* Structured problem-solving: separates symptoms from root cause and prioritises by business impact and control risk.
  
  
* Precision and control mindset: understands the financial, contractual and audit sensitivity of royalties operations.
  
  
* Collaboration and influence: earns trust across operations and technology, handles competing priorities and drives closure.
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

Works closely with Rights & Royalties Operations, Finance Operations, Transformation leads, Product/Technology, BI/Engineering, Compliance/Legal and operational leaders. title: Technical Project Manager - Media Tech
description:
**Technical Project Manager - Media Tech**

📍 Location: Noida, India (Work from Office)

**MANDATORY APPLICATION REQUIREMENT**

Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years and a maximum of 7 years of relevant experience. Please send your resume and a short cover letter to hiring@runn.tv.
**Only applications received at this email ID will be considered for evaluation**
. Candidates applying only through LinkedIn will not be considered.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly driven, detail-oriented and execution-focused Technical Project Manager to manage the development and delivery of RunnTV's media technology products.

The ideal candidate will combine a strong understanding of technology, software development and DevOps with excellent project management, stakeholder management and execution capabilities.

You will work closely with engineering, product, business and external partner teams to translate requirements into actionable plans, manage dependencies, resolve bottlenecks and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes complete ownership of project outcomes, anticipates risks and drives execution in a fast-paced product environment. You will contribute to products powering OTT streaming, channel playout and distribution, advertising, monetization and the broader Connected TV ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **End-to-End Project Management:**
   Own the project lifecycle from requirements and planning through development, testing, deployment and delivery.
2. **SDLC & Sprint Management:**
   Drive project plans, sprint planning, milestones, timelines and deliverables, ensuring adherence to commitments.
3. **Cross-functional Coordination:**
   Work closely with engineering, product, QA, DevOps, business teams and external partners to ensure smooth execution.
4. **Requirement Management:**
   Translate business and product requirements into clear specifications, actionable tasks and acceptance criteria.
5. **Stakeholder Management:**
   Maintain alignment on priorities, scope, timelines and expectations through effective communication and regular updates.
6. **Risk & Dependency Management:**
   Identify bottlenecks, technical dependencies and delivery risks early, and proactively drive their resolution.
7. **Release & Deployment Management:**
   Coordinate testing, UAT, CI/CD processes, release readiness, production deployments and post-release monitoring.
8. **Progress Tracking & Reporting:**
   Maintain project trackers, documentation and status reports, providing clear visibility into progress and blockers.
9. **Quality & Process Improvement:**
   Ensure delivery quality and continuously improve project workflows, accountability and execution efficiency.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

1. **4–7 years of relevant experience**
   in technical project management, software delivery, engineering program management or a similar role.
2. **Strong understanding of technology and SDLC**
   , including application architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, development, testing and deployment.
3. Hands-on experience managing software development projects from requirements through production release.
4. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management and project tracking.
5. **Strong understanding of DevOps practices**
   , including CI/CD pipelines, build and deployment processes, release management and production environments.
6. **Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills**
   , with the ability to coordinate technical and non-technical teams and manage competing priorities.
7. **Strong ownership mindset and bias for execution:**
   Proactively drive tasks to completion, resolve blockers and take responsibility for outcomes without constant follow-up.
8. **Exceptional attention to detail**
   , with a structured approach to requirements, documentation, timelines and delivery commitments.
9. Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and dependencies.
10. Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Trello or equivalent platforms.
11. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements and priorities.
12. **Preference will be given to candidates with experience in OTT, media technology, streaming platforms, Connected TV (CTV), ad tech or digital video products.**

**How to Apply**

If you understand technology, take ownership, pay attention to detail and have a strong bias for execution, we would love to hear from you.

Send your resume and a short cover letter to: hiring@runn.tv

**Subject Line:**
Application – Technical Project Manager

**Please note:**
This is a Work from Office role based in Noida. Candidates must have 4–7 years of relevant experience.

**About RunnTV**

RunnTV (runn.tv) is India's first independent and fastest-growing FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) platform, delivering free entertainment to Indian audiences through 24x7 thematic and curated channels.

We are building RunnTV with a vision to create the biggest free entertainment experience destination for Indians across the globe.

RunnTV has eMedia Investments, South Africa, as its strategic investor and is in a high-growth phase across its consumer streaming platform and media technology business, with a bold vision towards 2030.
