title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:**
No high-rated findings

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

• Builds teams from zero

• Customer-centric leadership

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

• Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.
* Governance, risk and controls
* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.
* People leadership, performance and culture
* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

****WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE****

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
**KPI**
**Indicative target**
**Payroll accuracy**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors
  
  
**On-time payment**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date
  
  
**Off-cycle payments**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused
  
  
**Statutory compliance**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time
  
  
**Vendor SLA adherence**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs
  
  
**Cost per payslip**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline
  
  
**Audit outcome**
No high-rated findings
  
  
*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*
****TECHNICAL SKILLS****

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**
Customer-centric leadership
  
  

* Builds teams from zero
* Drives change and adoption
* Sound judgement under pressure
* Influences without authority across countries
* Data-led decision making
* Coaches and develops talent
* Holds a high bar on control

****Essential****

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

****Preferred****

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Principal Consultant to join our team. As a consultant, you will provide strategic guidance and technical expertise to drive the success of our Drug Safety consulting operations. This position plays a key role in delivering innovative pharmacovigilance solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and advancing patient safety across complex global engagements. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, and contribute to client success from project planning through implementation and closeout. Responsibilities include leading solution design and implementation, mentoring technical teams, and ensuring adherence to industry best practices and Parexel methodologies.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through innovative pharmacovigilance solutions and client-centric delivery. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Pharmacovigilance Consulting Services Lead can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research, drug safety, and enterprise technology solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business needs and provide strategic guidance to ensure drug safety solutions meet customer objectives and drive successful project outcomes
* Lead solution design and implementation for client engagements, ensuring high-quality, integrated software solutions delivered within project constraints of time and budget
* Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, providing technical expertise in drug safety systems including Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, Analytics, OBIEE, and Axway EDI platforms
* Manage and mentor a team of technical consultants and developers, providing coaching, guidance, and feedback to develop team member skills and drive project success
* Present and demonstrate solutions to customers, influencing customer management in acceptance of solutions and ensuring successful business implementation
* Apply hands-on technical expertise in SQL and PL/SQL with strong troubleshooting skills across Veeva Systems, Axway, and associated modules to resolve complex technical challenges

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strategic thinking and technical leadership capabilities to guide complex drug safety implementations
* Deep experience in drug safety systems, implementation methodologies, and best practices
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
* Proven ability to lead teams, mentor consultants, and collaborate effectively across organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholder decisions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's / master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or any engineering degree
* 8+ years of experience relevant to this position, including 5 years of consulting experience in drug safety or clinical research
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with pharmacovigilance platforms such as Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, or similar systems
* Extensive knowledge of writing SQL queries and PL/SQL code
* In-depth knowledge of drug safety application implementation, upgrade, and maintenance
* Ability to craft and articulate strategic technology solutions that address complex business challenges

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with E2B(R3) or EDI protocols for adverse event reporting
* Familiarity with additional pharmacovigilance analytics and visualization tools
* Experience in consulting or client-facing roles within the pharmaceutical industry

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Principal Consultant - Project Management
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
Our UK Water business is growing fast — and we’re looking for a Principal Project Manager to help deliver most important water programs under AMP8.
  
  
In this role, Our Water Asset Design team works primarily in the municipal water sector as well as the non-regulated (industrial / international) sector. Our clients include some of the largest water companies in the UK, and contractors working in the sector. We deliver wastewater treatment, water treatment, sewerage, and water network schemes, as well as supporting other related industries. Our projects range in scope from routine network maintenance projects to some of the largest water projects in the UK.
  
  
We are currently recruiting for a Principal Project Manager to join our Water PMO team to lead the delivery of projects involving multidisciplinary teams from optioneering through delivery and handover to the Client.
  
  
You will be responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring and control, and completion of a defined project or defined work packages within a range of major projects or programmes to meet the clients project objectives. This includes leading, guiding and developing multi-disciplinary project teams, championing high quality delivery, and promoting a focus on health and safety.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**You will:**

* Manage project proposals including determining project requirements, scope, resources, programme, and cost estimates (budgets) for delivering the project
* Own the P&L with associated commercial and financial accountability including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing and cash collection
* Develop of project management documentation including project management plans, cost estimates and forecasts, risk registers, project schedules, stakeholder registers, project organisation charts etc. to successfully delivery the project objectives
* Monitor and control the project schedule, manhours, budgets, forecasts, and expenditure
* Ensure effective contract management including contract administration and change management
* Manage work being performed by project team members (including assistant PM’s working under your control), assuring outputs meet the project requirements
* Managing project deliverables, information, and records
* Effectively and accurately communicate relevant project information to the project team and customer
* Anticipate and take pre-emptive action to address issues and potential conflict situations that may impact on project delivery
* Lead multi-disciplinary project teams consisting of technical/professional staff and suppliers
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and captures lessons learned.

**Qualifications**
**What We’ll Love About You**

* You’re proactive, commercially aware and comfortable influencing at all levels. You can balance competing priorities, collaborate with technical experts and keep projects running smoothly, even across multiple offices and project streams.

**You will bring:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering and master degree in project management
* 12+ years’ experience and proven project delivery on water infrastructure projects
* Background in engineering consulting with design management experience highly desirable
* Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working across distributed teams
* Ability to manage multiple tasks across several live projects
* Solid understanding of contracts, change management and drafting variations
* High competency in cost reporting, financial analysis, Excel and Word
* Experience setting up systems for project files, data control and compliance
* Proven ability managing project budgets and using financial tools
* Strong written communication skills, including preparing high‑quality reports
* Proven experience in the delivery of infrastructure projects (exposure within the regulated water industry and / or non-regulated water projects would be highly advantageous but not essential)
* Working knowledge or accreditation in NEC supported with the necessary technical and practical skills to administer NEC Contracts
* Membership of professional institutions such as: Association for Project Management (APM), Project Management Institute (PMI) or Member of Institute of Civil Engineers (MICE) etc;
* Proficiency in use of project management tools and software;
* Demonstrate competence in stakeholder management, risk, planning/scheduling, and commercial management.

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.

Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**

title: Senior Project Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Join a global leader in energy transmission and help shape the future of power.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Project Engineering Manager to lead the engineering execution of large-scale EPC projects. You will oversee a diverse, international team and drive the successful delivery of engineering scopes on high-impact energy infrastructure High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) substation 1-2B$+ projects.
  
  
You will be part of the HVDC Solution Line and a member of our global Project Engineering Management (PEM) department, working alongside experienced project engineering managers across Europe, US, and Asia. In India, you will report directly to the India PEM team leader, contributing to a dynamic and diverse community of PEMs.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge HVDC technology, collaborate across global teams, and grow within an organization contributing to the energy transition.
  
  
**Job Description**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
As a
**Senior Project Engineering Manager**
, you will lead the successful execution of engineering activities for complex HVDC projects, ensuring alignment with project goals in terms of safety, schedule, cost, quality, and technical requirements.
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery of engineering activities of the HVDC SL scope of works on large EPC projects, ensuring alignment with schedule, budget, and technical requirements.
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, ensuring that deliverables are integrated, consistent, and aligned with project milestones.
* Act as the technical lead within the project, driving strategy, decision-making and managing interfaces between engineering, region, procurement, quality, construction, commissioning, and customers.
* Establish and maintain effective communication with customers, partners, and suppliers on technical topics, ensuring transparency, responsiveness, and trust.
* Anticipate and manage risks by maintaining an up-to-date risk register, driving mitigation plans, and enforcing a structured change management process.
* Ensure high standards of quality and compliance, applying internal processes, safety (EHS) requirements, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
* Represent engineering in project governance, providing clear reporting on project progress, issues, risks and KPIs, and contributing to key project reviews and decisions.
* Support site teams during execution, ensuring a smooth transition from design to construction and commissioning, and resolving technical issues efficiently.
* Mentor and empower project engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the engineering organization.
* Carry our regular and thorough reviews of the progress and delivery of the HVDC SL scope of work assessing all aspects of the project, including time, cost, quality, and risks.

Desired Profile and Experience
  
  

* Engineering degree in Electrical / Power Systems / Electronics / Automation
* 10+ years of experience as Project Engineering Manager or similar role in EPC environments: Energy, Transmission, Distribution, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, or similar industries
* A minimum of two projects delivered, managing medium to large size EPC projects. 10M$+ engineering budget managed.
* Strong project management skills and solid experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders, ideally across international and multicultural environments.
* Strong understanding of engineering project lifecycles, risk management, technical interfaces, and configuration/change control.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills: able to influence, align teams, and represent engineering with confidence in internal and customer meetings.
* Fluent in English.
* Comfortable with frequent national and international travel for project needs.

HVDC experience is a strong asset, but not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates with relevant experience in similar large-scale energy infrastructure and industrial EPC projects who are eager to learn and contribute to the energy transition.

No

title: Site Supervisor/Manager – Fit-Out and Interior
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Site Supervisor/Manager to oversee and coordinate the end-to-end execution of infrastructure development, civil works, interior fit-outs, and facility setup projects across multiple locations.

The role covers the physical setup of project sites, including civil modifications, interior works, electrical installations, lighting, furniture, fixtures, networking infrastructure, and other site-specific requirements.

The candidate should bring strong experience in site execution, vendor and contractor coordination, project scheduling, material planning, cost monitoring, and quality control. They should be able to manage multiple projects, resolve on-site challenges, and ensure timely completion in line with approved designs, budgets, and specifications. Experience in commercial interiors, office fit-outs, retail infrastructure, institutional projects, turnkey projects, or civil and interior execution is welcome. Exposure to EdTech, Innovation Labs, or educational infrastructure is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities – Project Execution & Site Management**

● Oversee end-to-end execution of infrastructure development, civil works, interior fit-outs, and facility setup projects.

● Conduct site surveys and assess infrastructure requirements, existing site conditions, and execution feasibility.

● Review approved layouts, drawings, BOQs, material specifications, and project requirements before execution begins.

● Prepare and maintain project execution schedules, timelines, milestones, and progress trackers.

● Coordinate civil and interior works, including flooring, painting, false ceilings, partitions, electrical fittings, lighting, furniture, storage, fixtures, and branding.

● Oversee site preparation and infrastructure readiness for IT, networking, AV, and other technology-related equipment.

● Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, workmanship, quality, and compliance with approved specifications.

● Identify site constraints, execution delays, and technical challenges, and coordinate timely resolutions.

● Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

● Identify, coordinate, and manage civil contractors, interior vendors, electricians, carpenters, fabricators, furniture suppliers, and other service providers.

● Coordinate multiple vendors and contractors to ensure smooth execution of project activities.

● Monitor vendor performance, workmanship, material quality, and adherence to agreed timelines.

● Review vendor quotations, work requirements, measurements, and execution costs with Procurement and relevant internal teams.

● Resolve vendor-related issues, execution conflicts, material shortages, and scheduling challenges.

● Ensure contractors follow applicable site safety requirements and approved work specifications.

● Maintain effective coordination between vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.

**Material Planning & Cost Control**

● Review BOQs, material requirements, quantities, and technical specifications.

● Coordinate with Procurement for timely sourcing and delivery of materials, furniture, fixtures, and equipment.

● Monitor material availability, consumption, and utilization to minimize shortages, wastage, and delays.

● Track project expenses and monitor costs against approved budgets.

● Identify potential cost overruns and recommend corrective measures.

● Verify completed work, measurements, and vendor deliverables before recommending payment approvals.

**Stakeholder Coordination & Project Monitoring**

● Act as the primary point of contact for day-to-day project execution and site-related coordination.

● Coordinate with customers, facility teams, vendors, contractors, and internal departments throughout execution.

● Provide regular updates on project progress, timelines, dependencies, and pending activities.

● Work with Sales, Pre-Sales, Procurement, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure smooth implementation.

● Coordinate changes in project requirements, layouts, or execution scope and obtain necessary approvals.

● Manage multiple projects simultaneously across different locations.

● Escalate critical execution issues, budget deviations, and project delays to management promptly.

**Quality Control & Project Handover**

● Ensure civil, interior, electrical, and installation works meet approved quality standards and project specifications.

● Conduct inspections to identify defects, incomplete work, and execution-related issues.

● Prepare and maintain snag lists and coordinate timely closure.

● Coordinate final inspections, installation checks, and site-readiness assessments.

● Maintain project documentation, including site survey reports, BOQs, progress reports, material records, vendor details, completion checklists, and handover documents.

● Ensure successful project completion and formal handover to customers and relevant internal teams.

● Identify opportunities to improve execution processes, vendor coordination, cost efficiency, and delivery.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

● Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

● 3–5 years of relevant experience in infrastructure execution, civil works, interior fit-outs, commercial interiors, turnkey projects, or site management.

● Proven experience coordinating multiple vendors, contractors, and on-site execution activities.

● Strong practical understanding of civil works, interior finishing, electrical installations, lighting, furniture, and related infrastructure activities.

● Experience in project planning, site supervision, material coordination, and execution monitoring.

● Ability to read and interpret floor plans, layouts, BOQs, measurements, and technical specifications.

● Experience in vendor coordination, quotation comparison, material planning, and project cost monitoring.

● Strong organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

● Working knowledge of MS Excel and project management or tracking tools.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate teams across different locations.

● Willingness to travel extensively across India for site surveys, project execution, inspections, and handovers.

**Preferred Experience**

● Experience in commercial interiors, office fit-outs, retail outlets, institutional infrastructure, or turnkey facility setup projects.

● Exposure to electrical infrastructure, IT networking, AV installations, or technology-enabled facility setups.

● Experience managing projects across multiple cities or locations.

● Familiarity with educational infrastructure, Innovation Labs, or Makerspaces is an added advantage, but not mandatory.

**What We Are Looking For**

● A proactive, hands-on project execution professional who can own the complete physical setup of a facility, from initial site survey through final handover.

● Strong practical experience in civil and interior execution, vendor coordination, contractor management, and site supervision.

● Ability to independently manage on-site activities, ensure material availability, resolve execution challenges, and deliver projects within defined timelines and budgets.

● Professionals with experience in commercial interiors, civil execution, turnkey infrastructure projects, and similar facility development projects are encouraged to apply.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

● Timely completion of projects against approved schedules.

● Adherence to approved project budgets and specifications.

● Quality of civil, interior, and infrastructure execution.

● Effective vendor and contractor coordination.

● Timely availability and efficient utilization of materials.

● Reduction in execution delays, rework, and material wastage.

● Timely identification and closure of project snags.

● Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.

● Successful project handover and customer satisfaction.

**Travel Requirement**

● Willingness to travel up to 50% across India is required.

title: Electrical Manager
description:

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

**Job Description**

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Electrical Manager**
to lead and oversee all electrical maintenance, utility operations, project execution, and reliability initiatives within the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in electrical systems, power distribution, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and team management. This role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted plant operations, compliance with safety standards, and continuous improvement in electrical performance and energy efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Electrical Maintenance & Operations

* Lead preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities for electrical equipment and systems.
* Ensure maximum uptime and reliability of electrical assets, including transformers, switchgear, motors, drives, and control panels.
* Monitor electrical system performance and implement improvement measures.
* Develop and execute maintenance schedules to minimize operational disruptions.

Project Management

* Manage electrical projects involving installation, commissioning, upgrades, and modernization of equipment.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure successful project delivery.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Location**
: Bengaluru/Noida; for projects across India

**A. About Varahe Analytics:**

Varahe Analytics is one of India’s premier integrated political consulting firms, specializing in building data-driven 360-degree election management. We help our clients with strategic advice and implementation, combining data-backed insights and in-depth ground intelligence into a holistic electoral campaign.

We are passionate about our democracy and the politics that shape our world. We draw on some of the sharpest minds from distinguished institutions and diverse professional backgrounds to help us achieve our goal of building electoral strategies that spark conversations, effect change, and help shape electoral and legislative ecosystems in our country.

**B. About the Team:**

We are seeking an experienced and proactive
**Research Manager**
to join our
**National Research Team**
. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of India's political and legislative landscape, with the ability to independently identify emerging research priorities and guide the team in developing high-quality research briefs and analytical notes.

The role requires strong research, writing, analytical, and editorial skills, along with the ability to interpret complex socio-economic data and translate findings into actionable recommendations for client messaging and strategy. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that the team's research outputs are accurate, insightful, relevant, and aligned with evolving political developments and client requirements.

**C. What Would This Role Entail?**

* Proactively track and identify political, legislative, governance, and socio-economic developments that require research attention. Identify briefs and notes that need to be picked up by the team and drive them from ideation to completion.
* Draft high-quality research briefs, policy briefs, analytical notes, backgrounders, and summaries. Review briefs prepared by National Research consultants to ensure accuracy, clarity, analytical depth, factual consistency, and relevance to the intended objective.
* Stay updated on political developments, legislative proceedings, policy announcements, government initiatives, and significant events across India. Assess their implications and identify relevant research opportunities for the team.
* Analyse raw socio-economic, demographic, governance, and public-policy data to identify meaningful trends and insights. Translate complex data into clear, evidence-based, and actionable policy and communications recommendations for the client.
* Validate information through credible sources, verify facts and figures, identify information gaps, and maintain high standards of accuracy and analytical rigour across all research outputs
* Guide National Research consultants on research questions, methodology, source selection, structure, and quality standards.
* Provide constructive feedback to improve the quality and relevance of research deliverables.
* Preempt and prioritise research assignments based on political developments, emerging issues, and project requirements. Manage multiple assignments simultaneously and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality briefs and notes.
* Willingness to travel across India as required for project needs, field research, stakeholder interactions, and other research-related assignments.
* Flexibility to work beyond standard business hours and remain available when required by urgent political developments, legislative proceedings, or time-sensitive project deliverables.
* Strong proficiency in identifying, accessing, analysing, and validating credible government and public-data sources, including Lok Sabha and other parliamentary records, RTI-based information, official government portals, ministry reports, and reputed research and statistical publications.

**D. Necessary Skills:**

**a) Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Technology, Political Science, Public Policy, Economics, Sociology, Law or a related discipline.

**b) Experience**

* 3–7 years of relevant professional experience in political research, public policy, corporate law or litigation, socio-economic research or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in drafting, editing, and reviewing research briefs, analytical notes, reports, and public policy documents.
* Experience in analysing socio-economic data and translating research findings into actionable insights.
* Familiarity and ease in dealing with quantitative data, and with formulating data analysis frameworks.
* Prior experience in establishing or guiding research teams, preferably in high-pressure environments.

**c) Skills**

* Strong understanding of India's political landscape, legislative developments, public policy, and governance issues.
* Strong analytical judgement and the ability to connect political developments, policy decisions, and socio-economic indicators with broader strategic implications.
* Ability to identify relevant research topics, develop structured research questions, evaluate sources, and synthesise complex information.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft concise, well-structured, and insight-driven research briefs and review documents prepared by others.
* Ability to interpret socio-economic and demographic datasets, identify trends, and convert findings into practical recommendations and communications material.
* Commitment to factual accuracy, source validation, and high-quality research outputs.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Docs and Sheets, Excel and familiarity with data analysis and research tools.
* Proficiency in multiple regional languages is preferred

**E. How to Apply**

If you're a professional looking for a high-impact challenge, interested in joining a team of like-minded and motivated individuals who think strategically, act decisively, and get things done, drop in an email at
openings@varaheanalytics.com

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Project Manager with 4-5 years of experience driving technical programs within engineering teams. The ideal candidate has strong command of SDLC processes, is fluent with Atlassian tooling, and has a track record of managing stakeholders across product, engineering, and senior leadership. This role requires someone who can run day-to-day program management with an agentic, ownership-driven mindset — proactively identifying risks, unblocking teams, and reporting on productivity without needing constant direction.

**Key Responsibilities**

•
**SDLC & Program Delivery:**

Plan, manage, and drive execution of technical programs across the full SDLC — from requirements and design through development, testing, release, and post-launch support.

 •
**Technical Program Management:**

Own sprint planning, backlog grooming support, release schedules, and cross-team dependency tracking for engineering programs. 

•
**Atlassian Tooling:**

Configure, maintain, and drive adoption of Jira, Confluence, and related Atlassian tools for project tracking, workflows, dashboards, and documentation. 

•
**Stakeholder Management:**

Partner closely with product managers, engineering leads, and senior leadership to align on priorities, timelines, trade-offs, and status; run steering/status meetings and executive updates.

 •
**Productivity Reporting:**

Track, analyze, and report team and program productivity metrics (velocity, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability) and translate them into actionable insights for leadership.

 •
**Risk Management:**

Proactively identify, log, and mitigate program and delivery risks; maintain risk registers and drive timely resolution of blockers and issues. 

•
**Agentic Program Ops:**

Independently manage day-to-day program operations — standups, follow-ups, documentation, and coordination — with an agentic, self-driven approach that minimizes hand-holding. 

•
**Documentation & Reporting:**

Maintain clear, up-to-date program documentation, RAID logs, roadmaps, and status reports accessible to all stakeholders.

 •
**Process Improvement:**

Identify opportunities to streamline SDLC processes, tooling, and reporting to improve team efficiency and delivery predictability. 

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

• 4-5 years of experience in project/program management, with a significant portion managing technical programs for engineering teams. 

• Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid models). 

• Hands-on, day-to-day experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), including dashboard and workflow configuration.

• Demonstrated experience managing stakeholders across product, technology, and senior leadership, including running executive-level updates. 

• Proven ability to define, track, and report productivity and delivery metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time, throughput). 

• Solid grounding in risk identification, tracking, and mitigation for technical programs. 

• Demonstrated ability to manage day-to-day program activities independently and proactively, with minimal supervision. 

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

title: Cluster Project Delivery Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

 • You have an engineering degree or equivalent working experience, with several years of management experience in construction, consultancy and/or contracting, preferably within the retail sector.
   

 • You have strong knowledge of construction management, project management, cost control, procurement, contracts, timelines, risk management and local permission processes.
   

 • You are passionate about delivering safe, compliant, sustainable and innovative property solutions while keeping business needs and lifecycle cost in mind.
   

 • You are an innovative, open\-minded and service\-minded leader who can lead both business and people, build strong relationships and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
   

 • You have experience developing people through coaching, training, performance management and career development.
   

  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 
  

 • Lead and manage all construction aspects of responsible building projects from start to finish, ensuring safe, compliant, sustainable and innovative delivery.
   

 • Develop and implement construction project delivery strategies, methods and procedures in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
   

 • Lead engagement with designers, contractors and partners to identify cost\-efficient and innovative project delivery solutions.
   

 • Work closely with Procurement and Engineering to define sourcing strategies, contractual models and effective design and construction methods.
   

 • Ensure project estimates, budgets, cost follow\-up, timelines and risk management are in place and aligned with investment requirements.
   

 • Lead and ensure procurement, contractors, permits, budgets and cost follow\-up are secured for responsible projects.
   

 • Ensure compliance with Health \& Safety requirements, including IWAY, as well as applicable construction standards and regulations.
   

 • Ensure completed areas are handed over for retail build\-up or tenant fit\-out according to the agreed scope and schedule.
   

 • Ensure competent resources are available throughout all phases of construction projects and manage team competence, performance and succession planning.
   

 • Create an environment where IKEA culture is strong and embraces the diversity of co\-workers and customers.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 Without us it would be difficult to meet our customers in person. In our team we find, develop and manage IKEA properties around the whole world. We’re different from one another but we are all passionate about real estate. We challenge and inspire each other to always stay close to IKEA customers and to understand how the changes within retail effects our needs of real estate.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

 From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

 Bengaluru / Noida / Mumbai

* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to gather inputs and ensure quality and consistency in reporting.
* Review technical assumptions embedded in financial models for utility\-scale power and water projects.
* Conduct buyer and seller due diligence as a technical advisor to stakeholders.
* Perform Capex and Opex benchmarking for utility scale power and water assets.
* Ensure adherence to health \& safety standards, quality management systems (QMS), and project lifecycle protocols.
* Participate in project meetings, contribute to business development efforts, and provide feedback on new opportunities.


**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) or related field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in infrastructure project development, construction, or technical advisory.
* Strong Conceptual understanding of PPP projects and Project Finance Fundamentals.
* Excellent report writing, analytical, soft skills and presentation skills.
* Technical expertise in any one of the utility sectors like Water/Wastewater treatment, Power Generation (Renewable and Non\-Renewable).
* Knowledge of project procurement process under PPP structure particularly those followed in Middle East region.
* Must have worked on Due Diligence reports for Lenders or other private investors preferable across Middle East.


**Desired skills:**

title: Team Lead - Software Development (DEX)
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day\-to\-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers.
   

  

 We’re looking for an experienced Team Lead in Software Development to manage and support our teams developing and enhancing our DEX capabilities, trusted by large enterprise customers. In this role, you’ll be essential to maintain a steady delivery cadence for the team, working with the different stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security, SRE) to ensure a clear prioritized Sprint backlog, and minimizing disruptions. You will translate high\-level vision into working services. You will communicate status clearly to all stakeholders, surfacing risks and impediments as they arise, and identifying ways forward – and escalating to leadership as needed. You will also coach and mentor your team members, guiding them in their personal and technical improvement, providing appropriate and timely feedback.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead a cross\-functional engineering team which focuses on maintaining and enhancing end\-to\-end services for our DEX solution deployed in Azure
* Align the team’s product roadmap in collaboration with Product Management
* Review the top items in Product Backlog, ensure they are well\-understood with clear description and acceptance criteria (breaking them down to smaller stories or creating spikes to understand them better) so that the team can story\-point them properly during Sprint Planning
* Work with the Product Owner/Product Manager to finalize the Sprint Backlog for each Sprint, by prioritizing the different workloads \- Product (Feature) roadmap; Customer requests and Sustain cases; Security vulnerabilities; Technical Debt; ad\-hoc work requests
* Be the single point of contact for all stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security team, SRE, other engineering teams, etc) to prevent disruptions to the team members
* Own all parts of the service lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, tracking and operations
* Continuously improve the product delivery process
* Deliver software meeting highest quality in terms of usability, stability, performance and security
* Be responsible for the quality the product the team delivers, as well as their overall effectiveness
* Utilize proven technical best practices to inspire and guide the team, ensure that their solutions can be used by other teams in an easy and flexible manner
* Ensure the personal and professional development of the team members to help them reach their full potential
* Provide guidance in regards to technical, process, or method\-related questions to the team, and enable and foster a culture of open feedback and communication


**Requirements**
* A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
* 10\+ years of software development experience on Product Development (on C\# .Net \& SQL – experience in Azure is a plus), with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team
* Experience contributing to cross\-team initiatives, coordinating with other team leads and team members (both remote and in\-person)
* Comfortable with working in high\-demand set\-up and ability to prioritize execution, hands\-on mentality
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
* Experience partnering with product and user experience teams
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top\-10 vulnerabilities \& remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
* Strong data\-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
* A pragmatic, outcome\-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
* A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
* Technical background is a plus \- experience in Docker, Kafka, DataBricks, ADO pipelines or Azure services (like AKS, Redis, Keyvault, EventHub, ServiceBus, SQL MI etc)
* Domain knowledge in end\-user computing and/or DEX is a plus
* Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages are a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

title: BIM Engineer - Building Technology Systems
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated BIM Engineer specializing in Building Technology Systems (ICT, Audio Visual, Security, BMS) to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and management of Building Information Modeling (BIM) strategies in our projects. This position requires proficiency in BIM software, a solid understanding of building technology systems, and excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with architects, engineers, and other stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain detailed BIM models for building technology systems, including ICT, Security, Audio\-Visua, and telecommunications.
* Collaborate with design teams to ensure integration of various building systems within the BIM environment.
* Conduct clash detection and resolution using BIM software to minimize system conflicts during the design phase.
* Provide technical support and guidance to project teams regarding best practices in BIM implementation and workflows.
* Ensure the accuracy and consistency of BIM documentation, including drawings, specifications, and project reports.
* Assist in the development and execution of BIM execution plans, including defining project goals, processes, and deliverables.

* Provide training and mentorship to junior staff in BIM practices and software tools.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Senior Project Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Senior Project Manager – HVDC is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects from contract award through commissioning and closeout. This role has full accountability for project performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, risk, and customer satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager coordinates multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and contract management functions to ensure successful project delivery in line with company objectives and contractual commitments and will report to the Project Director.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Project Leadership and Execution
* Lead with team end\-to\-end execution of HVDC projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with contract requirements, budget, schedule, and quality standards.
* Partner with Project Director to establish project execution strategy, governance, and delivery plans.
* Drive project performance across all phases including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between project scope, execution methodology, and customer expectations.
* Manage internal and external project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide leadership to cross\-functional and geographically dispersed project teams.
* Commercial and Financial Management
* Along with Project Director take ownership of project P\&L, cost control, margin protection, cash flow, and financial forecasting.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contingencies, and billing milestones.
* Identify and manage changes in scope, claims, variation orders, and contractual entitlements.
* Ensure robust contract/commercial management in cooperation with finance, commercial, and contract management teams.
* Drive opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.
* Schedule and Resource Management
* Support to develop and maintain integrated project schedules and key milestone plans.
* Support \& ensure appropriate allocation of project resources across engineering, supply chain, site execution, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor schedule progress and implement recovery plans when needed.
* Coordinate with functional managers to secure the required competencies and capacities for successful project delivery.
* Risk and Opportunity Management
* Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure timely implementation of mitigation actions.
* Anticipate project execution challenges related to technology, interfaces, supply chain, construction, grid connection, and regulatory requirements.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and propose practical solutions.
* Customer and Stakeholder Management
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction and trust.
* Lead customer meetings, project reviews, progress reporting, and executive\-level communications.
* Manage interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, utilities, consultants, and regulatory authorities as applicable.
* Contract and Claims Management
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Support interpretation of contract terms, management of obligations, and administration of key notices.
* Lead or support preparation and negotiation of claims, extensions of time, and change requests.
* Work closely with legal and contract management teams to protect company interests.
* Quality, Safety, and Compliance
* Promote and enforce a strong culture of EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer specifications, industry regulations, and applicable standards.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control throughout project execution.
* Ensure project lessons learned are captured and applied.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, IPMA, or equivalent is preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in project management, with significant experience in Large Infrastructure projects in the field of Transmission, Generation or O\&G. Experience in HVDC, FACTS technologies will be an added advantage.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large, complex, multidisciplinary projects of \> $100 M.
* Must have experience of working on global contracts (in multiple geographies) and hands on experience of partnering \& working with global teams from various countries and cultures.
* Strong experience in managing customer contracts, project financials, risks, and claims.
* Experience in international project environments and matrix organizations preferred.
* Experience with utility, transmission system operator (TSO), or grid projects is highly desirable.


**Required Skills**
* Understanding of HVDC systems, power transmission projects, and large infrastructure delivery.
* Excellent project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Strong technical, commercial and contractual acumen.
* Leadership skills with the ability to manage large cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with project planning, reporting, and financial management tools.
* Familiarity with EPC contract models and consortium project execution.
* Ability to manage multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting skills.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes
